To get the 1st gear inner sleeve off the shaft, use good "C" plates which clamp around the flange, then apply good heat with a hot air gun and press it off.

Since the brake booster only works with the engine running, greater force will be required on the brake pedal of cars with a brake booster when the "engine is stopped".

Remove clutch by following the procedure in section 21 21 000.
What diameter hole should be drilled to begin breaking the starter gear ring?
Drill a 6 mm (0.236") diameter hole approximately 8 mm (0.315") deep below a tooth gap to make breaking the gear ring easier.
How should the drilled starter gear ring be broken?
Break the gear ring at the drilled point with a chisel.
What is the minimum distance A for the friction surface machining specification?
The friction surface may be machined to the minimum distance A = 29.1 - 0.1 mm (1.146 - 0.004").
What temperature range should the new starter gear ring be heated to during installation?
Heat the new starter gear ring to 200...230°C (395 to 445°F).
What should be used to measure the temperature of the starter gear ring during heating?
Measure temperature with a thermo-color pencil.
How should the heated starter gear ring be positioned during installation?
The tooth bevel faces the engine. Knock on starter gear ring to fit firmly all around with a brass mandrel.
What type of bolts should be used when installing the flywheel?
Install new expansion bolts with Loctite No. 270.
What must be done to the tapped bores before flywheel installation?
Clean tapped bores before installation.
What is the tightening torque for the O-rings during installation?
The tightening torque is 9 Nm (6.5 ft. lbs.).
What should be done with the coolant during engine removal?
Drain coolant on engine and radiator.
How should the accelerator cable and cruise control cable be handled?
Disconnect accelerator cable (1) and cruise control cable (2), unscrew nuts (3) on holder and lay cables with holder aside.
What needs to be done with the intake manifold hose?
Loosen hose clamp (1) and pull off hose on intake manifold, then unscrew nut (2) on intake manifold brace.
Which group should be referenced for cooling system bleeding procedures?
See Group 17 for fill and bleed cooling system procedures.
What steps are required for removing the ignition system components?
Pull off ignition lead (1) on ignition coil, pull off plugs (2 and 3), unscrew nut (4) and lay lead aside on opposite end of engine.
What should be removed from the coolant expansion tank area?
Loosen hose clamps (1 and 2) and pull off hoses on coolant expansion tank, then unscrew nut (3) and take off ground strap.
What is the approval status for grinding cylinder heads according to the manual?
Approval has not yet been given for grinding cylinder heads.
How can the cylinder head be cleaned instead of grinding?
The cylinder head may be cleaned by wheting on a surface plate.
What special tool is required for checking cylinder head cracks in the water test?
Special Tool 11 1 111 is required.
What air pressure should be applied to the cylinder head during the crack testing procedure?
Apply air pressure to cylinder head - 2 bar (28 psi) testing pressure.
Where should the cylinder head be placed during the crack testing procedure?
Place cylinder head in a water bath and check for cracks.
What special tools are needed for the procedure shown in figure 14 31?
Special Tools 11 1 012, 11 1 112, and 11 1 113 are required.
What should be done with the water bath if necessary during testing?
If necessary, relax the water bath with a detergent.
What components are labeled as 1 and 2 in figure 14 29?
Component 1 is the connector to unscrew, and component 2 is the plug opening with bolt - copper bolt from M 30 exhaust manifold.
What procedure is being demonstrated in section 11 12 719?
Grinding cylinder head sealing surface with the cylinder head disassembled.
What type of bolt should be used in the plug opening according to the instructions?
A copper bolt from M 30 exhaust manifold should be used.
What important note is given regarding the water bath during cylinder head testing?
If necessary, relax the water bath with a detergent.
What special tool is required to unscrew the spark plugs?
Special Tool 12 1 160 is required to unscrew the spark plugs.
What is the procedure for checking compression of all cylinders?
First unscrew trim panel and pull off master relay (2), then unscrew nuts (1) on ignition lead pipe and pull off spark plug connectors, followed by unscrewing spark plugs with Special Tool 12 1 160.
What special tool is needed for the compression testing adapter?
Special Tool 11 0 165 is needed for the testing adapter to connect the compression tester.
What is the acceptable compression specification range for all cylinders?
The specification is 10 to 11 bar (142 to 156 psi), and the value of all cylinders should not deviate by more than 0.5 bar (7 psi).
What should be done with the accelerator pedal during the compression test?
Press down on the accelerator pedal and operate starter until the compression stops rising.
What is the maximum allowable deviation between cylinder compression values?
The compression values of all cylinders should not deviate by more than 0.5 bar (7 psi) from each other.
What is the first step in the compression checking procedure?
The first step is to unscrew the trim panel and pull off the master relay (2).
What procedure reference number is this compression checking procedure?
This is procedure 11 00 039 for checking compression of all cylinders.
How should the starter be operated during the compression test?
Operate the starter until the compression stops rising while keeping the accelerator pedal pressed down.
What should be done with the trim panel and master relay before checking compression?
Unscrew the trim panel and pull off the master relay (2).
How do you remove the spark plug connectors for compression testing?
Unscrew nuts (1) on ignition lead tube and pull off spark plug connectors.
What is the tightening torque specification for spark plug installation?
The tightening torque is 20 Nm (14.5 ft. lbs.).
Which special tool should be used to connect the compression tester?
Screw in Special Tool 11 0 165 and connect the compression tester.
What is the proper procedure for operating the engine during compression testing?
Press down the accelerator pedal and operate the starting motor so long, until compression no longer rises.
What is the nominal compression value range for these cylinders?
The nominal value is 10 to 11 bar (145 to 155 psi).
What components are indicated by callout numbers 1, 2, and 3 in the first diagram?
The callouts show components related to the trim panel removal and master relay (2) location, with numbered reference points (1 and 3) for the procedure.
What does callout number 1 indicate in the ignition lead tube diagram?
Callout number 1 indicates the nuts that need to be unscrewed on the ignition lead tube to remove the spark plug connectors.
What is shown in the bottom diagram with the compression tester setup?
The bottom diagram shows Special Tool 11 0 165 screwed into the spark plug hole and connected to a compression tester gauge for measuring cylinder compression.
What should be done to the lower oil pan section when unscrewing the reinforcement plate?
The lower oil pan section should be removed - see section 11 13 020.
What product should be used when installing bolts 1 through 3?
Install bolts (1 ... 3) with Loctite No. 270.
How many bolts need to be loosened on the remaining oil pan bolts according to the procedure?
Loosen remaining oil pan bolts and unscrew bolts (4).
What components need to be removed according to the references provided in the middle section?
Remove water pump (see 11 51 000), remove pulley on crankshaft (see 11 21 120), and remove piston for chain tensioner (see 11 31 090).
What tool should be used to loosen the oil pan gasket on the timing case cover?
Loosen oil pan gasket on timing case cover carefully with a knife.
What should be done if the oil pan gasket is damaged during removal?
If oil pan gasket is damaged, remove oil pan and replace gasket - see 11 13 000.
What should be used to break the upper edges of the timing case cover during installation?
Break upper edges with a file.
What product should be applied to the sealing surfaces during timing case cover installation?
Coat sealing surfaces with Three Bond Silicone 1207.
What should be done to new gaskets during installation?
Install new gaskets, coat with Three Bond Silicone 1207 and cut off ends.
How should the mating surfaces be prepared during installation?
Coat mating surfaces with Three Bond Silicone 1207.
What is the final step mentioned for the timing case cover installation?
Guide in cover uniformly.
What is the source attribution shown at the bottom of the page?
Source: HWB
What is the main topic covered in section 11 12 100?
Removing and installing cylinder head.
What should be done with the cooling system before removing the cylinder head?
Fill and bleed cooling system - see Gr. 17.
Which components need to be disconnected first when removing the cylinder head?
Disconnect battery ground lead, unscrew splash guard, and remove coolant on engine and radiator.
What do callout numbers 4 and 5 indicate in the air cleaner removal diagram?
Nuts that need to be loosened to remove the air cleaner.
What should be checked during installation of the intake manifold?
Check O-rings, replacing if necessary.
How should the electric leads be handled when removing plugs 2 and 3?
Pull off plugs (2 and 3) and place electric leads aside.
What should be done with the throttle cable and cruise control cable?
Disconnect throttle cable (1) and cruise control cable (2).
What is the procedure for the vacuum hose connected to the brake booster?
Unscrew nut (3), pull off clamp and lift vacuum hose (1) out of brake booster.
What do callouts 1 and 2 represent in the intake manifold removal diagram?
Hose clamp (1) and nut (2) on intake manifold support that need attention during removal.
What needs to be done with the vacuum hose and pressure regulator?
Pull vacuum hose (3) off of pressure regulator and unscrew screw (4) to take off electric lead with holder.
What is the tightening torque specification for the air intake manifold installation?
The tightening torque is 9 Nm (6.5 ft. lbs.).
What should be checked when installing O-rings during the air intake manifold installation?
Check O-rings, replacing if necessary.
What are the first steps when removing the engine according to procedure 11 00 050?
Disconnect battery ground lead, remove transmission (see Gr. 23), unscrew splash guard, drain coolant on engine and radiator, and remove air filter.
Where can you find information about filling and bleeding the cooling system?
Fill and bleed cooling system - see Gr. 17.
What components are indicated by callout numbers 1, 2, and 3 in the top right diagram showing hose clamp removal?
The callouts show the process of loosening hose clamps and pulling hoses off of the coolant expansion tank, with number 3 indicating unscrewing the nut and taking off the ground strap.
What procedure should be followed when disconnecting the throttle cable and cruise control cable?

Disconnect throttle cable (1) and cruise control cable (2), unscrew nuts (3) on holder and place cables with holder aside, then unscrew nut (4), pull off clamp and lift vacuum hose (5) out of brake booster.
What are the numbered components in the middle left diagram showing throttle cable disconnection?
1 - throttle cable, 2 - cruise control cable, 3 - nuts on holder, 4 - nut for clamp, 5 - vacuum hose from brake booster.
What should be done with the ignition lead and plugs during engine removal?
Pull ignition lead (1) off of ignition coil, pull off plugs (2 and 3), unscrew nut (4) and place electric lead on opposite end of engine.
How do you remove the intake manifold hose according to the bottom left procedure?
Loosen hose clamp (1) and pull hose off of intake manifold, then unscrew nut (2) on intake manifold support.
What is shown in callout numbers 3 and 4 in the alternator disconnection diagram?
3 and 4 indicate the nuts that need to be unscrewed to take off the electric leads from the alternator.
What electric components need to be disconnected from the alternator?
Disconnect electric leads (1 and 2) on alternator, unscrew nuts (3 and 4) and take off electric leads.
Which numbered components are shown in the fuel injector and pressure regulator removal procedure?
The diagram shows numbered components 1, 2, and 3, with component 1 being the clamp to loosen, and components 2 and 3 being the fuel hoses to disconnect on the injection pipe.
What important warning is given about the fuel hoses during the breather pipe disconnection procedure?
The manual warns not to mix up hoses 2 and 3 during installation.
What should be done with the cam followers after removing the camshaft?
The cam followers should be pulled out using Special Tool 11 3 030 and placed in a tray, then installed in the same positions during reassembly.
Which hose number represents the heater hose that should be disconnected on the cylinder head?
Hose number 4 is the heater hose that should be disconnected on the cylinder head.
What needs to be replaced during the oxygen sensor installation procedure?
The gaskets and self-locking nuts need to be replaced during oxygen sensor installation.
What reference section should you consult for camshaft removal details?
You should see section 11 31 000 for camshaft removal details.
What is the purpose of the longer bolt mentioned in the cylinder head removal procedure?
The longer bolt (1) is required to secure the shaft for the upper tensioning rail during installation.
What should be done with the radiator hoses during the cylinder head removal process?
The hose clamps should be loosened and the radiator hoses should be pulled off.
What components are numbered 1, 2, and 3 in the cylinder head removal diagram at the bottom of the page?
In the bottom diagram, component 1 appears to be a bolt or fastener that needs to be unscrewed as part of the cylinder head removal process.
What pressure does the pressure safety valve regulate at?
The pressure safety valve regulates at 8 bar (114 psi).
How do you test if the oil pump runs easily?
Check whether oil pump runs easily by turning the drive shaft.
What should you check for when inspecting the oil pump for wear?
Check for scoring in the body and wear on rotors.
What is the length specification for spring (9) in the pressure safety valve?
The length of spring (9) should be 44 ± 0.4 mm (1.732 ± 0.016 inches).
What tool is needed to install spring (9) and washer (10)?
Press in spring (9) and washer (10) with a wrench socket and install circlip (11).
What components are numbered 6 and 7 in the pressure safety valve diagram?
Component 6 is the piston and component 7 is the spring.
What should you do before removing the timing chain according to section 11 31 051?
Remove lower oil pan section as described in section 11 13 020.
What is the tightening torque specification for the oil pump drive chain?
The tightening torque is 25 to 30 Nm (18 to 22 ft. lbs.).
What color coding distinguishes different chain lengths?
Chains with green code are longer than chains with red code.
Where is the pressure safety valve located in the engine?
The pressure safety valve is located in the main bore and regulates the engine oil pressure.
What should be checked during sprocket installation for the oil pump drive chain?
Check sprockets for wear and adjust chain tightness according to section 11 41 000.
What is the nominal spring length for the chain tensioner spring?
What is the tightening torque for the chain tensioner plug?
What safety warning is given for the chain tensioner spring?
Strong spring pressure.
What should be done during installation regarding the spring's wound end?
Conically wound end of spring faces plug (1).
How should the cylinder be positioned during installation?
Install cylinder with groove facing back (as seen looking forward in car) and position with groove facing up.
What components are matched according to the manual?
Piston (4) and cylinder (5) are matched - code 1 or 2. Only install parts with same code.
What should be added to the nipple during installation?
Add engine oil, until oil runs out of nipple (7).
In the exploded diagram, what does callout number 3 represent?
The spring component of the chain tensioner assembly.
What should be done with the O-ring on the nipple?
Unscrew nipple (7) - replace O-ring (8) if necessary.
What needs to be checked during installation regarding spring length?
Check length of spring (3) and ensure it meets the nominal value of 159 ± 0.5 mm.
How should the piston opening be guided during installation?
Guide piston opening into tensioning rail.
What special tool is used to turn the crankshaft to position cylinder no. 1 to TDC?
Special Tool 11 3 020 is used to turn the crankshaft to position cylinder no. 1 to TDC - cylinder no. 4 overlaps.
What is the tightening torque specification for the chain tensioner installation?
The tightening torque is 9 ± 1 Nm (6.5 ± 0.5 ft lbs.).
What important caution is given regarding the engine after removing the timing chain?
Never crank the engine after removing the timing chain.
Which special tool is mounted on the timing case to hold the camshaft in TDC position?
Special Tool 11 3 010 is mounted on the timing case and used to turn shaft up to the arrest - camshaft is held down for removal of bearing caps.
What procedure is used for centering the guide rail during installation?
Center guide rail with a feeler gage.
How should camshafts be marked and installed according to the instructions?
Mark camshafts "E" or "A" and remove. For installation, camshafts are identical for exhaust and intake sides, and you should install a used camshaft in the same direction.
What should be done with lockplates and sprockets during chain tensioner removal?
Open lockplates and unscrew sprockets.
Where can information about removing the chain tensioner be found?
Remove chain tensioner - see 11 31 090.
What is the proper position for installing the camshaft according to the TDC procedure?
Turn crankshaft to TDC and install camshaft so that each groove faces up and inward - TDC position.
What should be done after loosening the arrest and relaxing the camshaft?
Remove Special Tool 11 3 010.
How is the camshaft held in position when Special Tool 11 3 020 is used with Special Tool 11 3 010?
Hold camshaft in TDC position with Special Tool 11 3 020 and turn shaft up to the arrest - camshaft is held down for installation of bearing caps.
What is the tightening torque specification for the oil drain plug?
The oil drain plug should be tightened to 33 Nm (24 ft. lbs.).
What steps are required before removing the oil pan upper section?
First pull out the oil dipstick, then remove the oil pan lower section (see 11 13 020), remove the oil pump (see 11 41 000), and remove the reinforcement plate.
What preparation is needed for the oil pan lower section removal?
Remove the splash guard, drain the engine oil, and unscrew the oil pan bolts.
What should be done with the sealing surfaces during oil pan installation?
Clean the sealing surface and replace the oil pan gasket.
What special compound is mentioned for sealing during installation?
Universal sealing compound should be used, applied with a brush on the timing case cover and end cover joints.
What components need to be disconnected in the oil pan upper section removal?
Disconnect the plug, unscrew the holder and ground lead, and loosen the clamp to pull off the bleeding hose.
What cross-reference is provided for additional service information?
See Service Information of Gr. 00 for additional details.
What should be done with the gasket during oil pan installation?
Replace the oil pan gasket during installation.
What engine fluid needs to be addressed during the oil pan lower section procedure?
Pour in engine oil during installation, after the oil has been drained during removal.
What special tool is required to hold the pulley when removing the fan?
Special Tool 11 5 030 is required to hold the pulley when unscrewing the coupling nut.
What is the tightening torque specification for the fan installation?
The tightening torque is 40 + 10 Nm (29 + 7 ft. lbs.), which equals a 30 Nm (22 ft. lbs.) setting on the torque wrench.
Which direction must the fan coupling nut be turned to unscrew it?
The fan coupling nut has left-hand threads, so it must be turned clockwise to unscrew it.
What are the conditions that require replacing the fan clutch?
The fan clutch must be replaced if the hub has seized, the fan of stopped engine cannot be turned or is hard to turn, the fan clutch has axial or radial play, or is losing oil.
What tool is shown in diagram 11 5 040?
Diagram 11 5 040 shows a special wrench or tool used for fan clutch service.
What is the first step when removing the coolant thermostat?
The first step is to drain coolant and loosen hose clamps, then remove the thermostat.
What temperature range should the thermostat begin to open?
The thermostat should begin to open at 80 ± 2°C (176 ±3°F) with 0.1 mm (0.004 inch) travel.
What is the testing temperature and travel specification for the thermostat?
Testing temperature is 95°C (203°F) with 8 mm (0.315 inch) travel.
How should the thermostat be checked for proper operation?
Place the thermostat in water and heat the water, then measure the temperature at which the thermostat begins to open and the distance with a steel ruler.
What should be done to check the switching points on the fan clutch?
Check switching points with a Vibrocard, unscrew fan mounting bolts and take off the fan clutch.
What section should be referenced for bleeding the cooling system during thermostat installation?
See section 17 11 000 for bleeding the cooling system.
What important note is given regarding the fan coupling nut threading?
There is an important note that the fan coupling nut has left-hand threads and must be turned clockwise to unscrew.
What are the steps for removing the pulley from the crankshaft?
Unscrew nut on pulley, then pull off pulley.
What should be checked during installation of the crankshaft pulley?
Check for correct installed position of woodruff key (1).
What section reference number is this procedure classified under?
11 21 120 REMOVING AND INSTALLING PULLEY ON CRANKSHAFT.
What diagram numbers are referenced for the flywheel holding procedure?
What diagram number corresponds to checking the woodruff key position?
What is the critical inspection point during pulley installation?
Check for correct installed position of woodruff key (1).
What engine designation is used for the BMW M3 according to this service manual?
The BMW M3 uses Engine S 14 Z.
What is the page reference for cylinder head sealing surface procedures when the cylinder head is disassembled?
Cylinder head sealing surface (cylinder head disassembled) procedures are on page 11-55.
Where can I find the procedure for replacing the crankshaft main bearing shells with the engine disassembled?
The procedure for replacing crankshaft main bearing shells (engine disassembled) is found on page 11-61b.
What service procedure is listed under section 11 14 141?
Section 11 14 141 covers radial oil seal in lower timing case cover - replace.
On which page would I find information about starter gear ring replacement?
Starter gear ring replacement information is on page 11-63.
What type of Plastigage should be used when installing the crankshaft?
Type PG-1 Plastigage should be placed on the crankshaft wiped clean of oil and tighten bearing caps with the correct torque.
Where can Plastigage be obtained according to the manual?
Plastigage can be obtained from CARTOOL, Alfred-Brehm-Str. 5, D-8070 Ingolstadt.
What are the three-step tightening torque specifications for conrod bolts?
Step 1: 10 Nm (7 ft. lbs.), Step 2: 30 Nm (22 ft. lbs.), Step 3: 60° + 2° torque angle.
What is the acceptable conrod bearing play range?
The conrod bearing play should be 0.024 to 0.064 mm (0.0009 to 0.0025 inches).
What important instruction is given about turning the crankshaft during installation?
Do not turn the crankshaft during the installation process.
What do the color codes Rt and Bl represent in the bearing classification system?
Rt = red and Bl = blue according to the Double Classification Color Codes.
What four measurements are indicated in the crankshaft bearing diagram?
The diagram shows: 1. Crankshaft diameter, 2. Bearing play, 3. Bearing shell thickness, 4. Console diameter.
What precaution should be taken when installing new bearing shells?
Correct the bearing play by installing new bearing shells, bearing shells of a different machined size or with different color code marks.
What determines which color conrod bearing shells should be installed?
Red or blue conrod bearing shells are installed standard depending on the color code mark on the connecting rod for a pertinent crankshaft ground size.
What should be done with conrod caps and bearing shells before installation?
Place Type PG-1 Plastigage on conrod bearing journals wiped clean of oil in BDC position. Mount conrod caps with pair codes and grooves of bearing shells on the outside.
What type of bolts should be used for final conrod installation?
Use new conrod bolts for final installation.
What special tool is required to unscrew the full flow oil filter?
Special Tool 11 4 020 is required to unscrew the full flow oil filter.
How should the gasket be prepared during oil filter installation?
The gasket should be lubricated with a light coat of oil before installation.
What is the proper tightening procedure for the oil filter after the gasket contacts the surface?
After the gasket bears on the surface, tighten the filter by hand one half turn more.
What should be done after adding oil and starting the engine?
Start the engine and check oil level as well as for leaks.
At what temperature does the temperature regulator switch off the oil cooler?
The temperature regulator switches off the oil cooler at approximately 95°C (203°F).
What does callout number 1 indicate in the oil filter diagram?
Callout number 1 indicates the line from the oil cooler.
What special procedure is mentioned if the engine no longer builds up oil pressure after filter replacement?

If the engine no longer builds up oil pressure after replacement of the oil filter cartridge, stop the engine, turn the filter cartridge approximately 90° and tighten it again after starting the engine and waiting until a small amount of oil escapes from the filter (bleeding procedures).
What does callout number 2 represent in the oil system diagram?
Callout number 2 represents the line to the oil cooler.
What component is identified by callout number 3?
Callout number 3 identifies the temperature regulator that switches off the oil cooler at approximately 95°C (203°F).
What is the section reference number for this oil filter replacement procedure?
The section reference number is 11 42 021.
What safety precaution should be taken regarding oil pressure after filter cartridge replacement?
If the engine no longer builds up oil pressure after replacement, immediately stop the engine to prevent damage.
What is the procedure number and title for this engine service operation?
11 12 000 REMOVING AND INSTALLING CYLINDER HEAD COVER
What should you do after removing the nuts and hoses from the cylinder head cover?
Unscrew nuts and take off cylinder head cover.
What component should be checked during installation of the cylinder head cover?
Check gaskets, replacing if necessary.
What does callout number 2 point to in the procedure?
Callout number 2 points to the hose clamp that needs to be loosened before pulling off the breather hose.
What type of hose is connected to the cylinder head cover that needs to be removed?
A breather hose that is connected via a hose clamp.
What ignition system components need to be disconnected before removing the cylinder head cover?
The spark plug connectors and ignition lead pipe need to be disconnected.
How many main steps are shown in the cylinder head cover removal process?
Two main steps are shown - the first involving disconnecting various components and hoses, and the second involving unscrewing nuts to remove the cover itself.
What should be done with gaskets during cylinder head cover installation?
The gaskets should be checked and replaced if necessary during installation.
What engine branding is visible on the cylinder head cover in the diagrams?
BMW M Power branding is visible on the cylinder head cover.
What is the installation note provided for this procedure?
Installation: Check gaskets, replacing if necessary.
What is the tightening torque specification for spark plugs during installation?
The tightening torque for spark plugs is 20 ± 5 Nm (14.5 ± 3.5 ft. lbs.).
Which special tool is used to pull off the valve stem seal?
Special Tool 11 1 250 is used to pull off the valve stem seal.
What should be done to the valve guide and valve stem during installation?
Lubricate the valve guide and valve stem with oil during installation.
What special tools are required to mount Special Tools 11 1 068, 11 1 052 and 11 1 067?
Special Tool 11 1 051 is required to mount Special Tools 11 1 068, 11 1 052 and 11 1 067.
What diameters are available for Special Tool 11 1 200 valve stem seals?
Special Tool 11 1 200 has two diameters available - for 7 and 8 mm (0.275 and 0.315 in.) valve stem seals.
What procedure should be followed to compress valve springs and remove valve collets?
Compress valve springs and remove valve collets. Place Special Tool 11 1 053 (tray) in the assembly stand and pull out rubber part.
What is the purpose of Special Tool 11 1 360 when installing valves?
Special Tool 11 1 360 is used to avoid damaging the valve stem seal during installation.
What should be done with the valve stem seal after installation?
Lubricate the valve stem seal with oil and install it. Press on the valve stem seal with Special Tool 11 1 200 by hand.
What components need to be removed from the upper spring retainer assembly?
Remove the upper spring retainer and double spring set, then take the tray out of the assembly stand and pull out the valve.
Where can Special Tool Sleeves be sourced from according to the manual?
Special Tool Sleeves can be sourced from CARTOOL, Alfred Brehm Str. 5, D - 8070 Ingolstadt.
What reference should be checked for valve guide wear inspection?
Check valve guide for wear - see 11 12 595 for the inspection procedure.
What is the first step in removing valves with the cylinder head removed?
Unscrew spark plugs, then mount the cylinder head on Special Tool 11 1 065 with Special Tools 11 1 054.
What is the procedure section number for removing and installing the cylinder head cover?
The procedure section number is 11 12 000.
What are the first steps to remove the cylinder head cover?
First unscrew nuts (1), then pull off spark plug connectors, take off ignition lead tube, and loosen hose clamp (2) and pull off bleeder hose.
What is the final step for cylinder head cover removal?
Unscrew nuts and take off cylinder head cover.
Which hose needs to be disconnected during cylinder head cover removal?
The bleeder hose needs to be disconnected after loosening hose clamp (2).
What component is visible in the bottom diagram that shows the BMW M Power branding?
The bottom diagram shows the cylinder head cover with BMW M Power branding after removal.
What electrical connections must be removed before taking off the cylinder head cover?
The spark plug connectors must be pulled off and the ignition lead tube must be taken off.
What is shown in the installation note for the cylinder head cover procedure?
The installation note states to check gaskets, replacing if necessary.
What type of clamp needs to be loosened during the procedure?
A hose clamp (2) needs to be loosened to pull off the bleeder hose.
What should be inspected before reinstalling the cylinder head cover?
The gaskets should be inspected and replaced if necessary during installation.
What is the tightening torque specification for oil pan bolts during installation?
The tightening torque for oil pan bolts is 10 Nm (7 ft. lbs.).
What torque should be applied to the oil drain plug?
The oil drain plug should be tightened to 33 Nm (24 ft. lbs.).
What are the four numbered components shown in the left diagram during oil pan upper section removal?
The numbered components are: 1) plug connection, 2) holder with ground lead, 3) clamp, and 4) breather hose connection point.
What should be done with the engine oil before removing the oil pan lower section?
The engine oil should be drained before removing the oil pan lower section.
What special sealing procedure is required during oil pan installation?
The sealing surface must be cleaned, the oil pan gasket replaced, and the joint on timing case cover and end cover coated with a brush-on universal sealing compound.
What component must be removed according to section 11 41 000?
The oil pump must be removed according to section 11 41 000.
What should be done with the splash guard during oil pan lower section removal?
The splash guard should be unscrewed during oil pan lower section removal.
What is the proper sequence for disconnecting components from the oil pan upper section?
First disconnect the plug, then unscrew the holder and ground lead, and finally loosen the clamp and pull off the breather hose.
What type of sealing compound is specified for the timing case cover joint?
A brush-on universal sealing compound is specified for coating the joint on timing case cover and end cover.
What should be done with the reinforcement shell during oil pan removal?
The reinforcement shell should be unscrewed during the oil pan removal process.
What is the source of supply indicated at the bottom of the page?
The source of supply is HWB, as indicated by the double asterisk notation.
What engine designations are listed at the bottom of this page?
BMW 320 is - Engine S 14 B 20 and BMW M 3 - Engine S 14 B 23 are listed at the bottom of the page.
What text is visible on the engine valve cover in the illustration?
The valve cover displays 'BMW M Power' text on top of the engine.
What major engine components are visible in this cutaway illustration?
The illustration shows the cylinder head with valve cover, engine block with pistons and cylinders, crankcase, oil pan, exhaust manifold, intake manifold, and cooling system components.
How is the engine oriented in this illustration?
The engine is shown at an angle that displays the front and one side, providing a three-dimensional perspective of the complete assembly.
What can you see of the internal engine components in this cutaway view?
The cutaway view reveals the pistons, connecting rods, crankshaft, valvetrain components, and internal passages within the engine block and cylinder head.
What external accessories and components are visible on the engine?
External components visible include the alternator, various hoses and lines, the exhaust manifold, intake manifold, and what appears to be engine mounting points.
What tool is specified for removing piston rings?
Remove piston rings with a piston ring pliers.
How should piston rings be installed according to the installation instructions?
Install piston rings with "TOP" facing the piston crown.
What are the three types of piston rings shown in the diagram?
1 Plain compression ring, 2 Bevelled face compression ring, 3 Oil scraper ring with rubber lined spring.
What is the procedure number for replacing piston rings of one piston?
What measurement should be taken using the bottom illustration?
Measure end clearance.
What marking indicates the top face of piston rings during installation?
"TOP" marking should face the piston crown.
What component number 3 represents in the piston ring diagram?
Oil scraper ring with rubber lined spring.
Where can specifications for the measurements be found?
See Specifications.
What is the first step in the piston ring replacement procedure?
The piston must be removed before replacing piston rings.
What type of compression ring is shown as component number 2?
Bevelled face compression ring.
What clearances need to be measured during piston ring service?
Both side clearance and end clearance need to be measured.
What should be done with the coolant system during installation according to this page?
Fill and bleed cooling system - see Group 17.
What is the specified tightening torque for the intake manifold nuts?
9 Nm (6.5 ft. lbs.)
What components should be pulled off after loosening hose clamp 1 in the middle left image?
Pull off plugs (2 and 3) and lay leads aside. Loosen nuts (4 and 5) and remove air cleaner.
What cables need to be disconnected according to the bottom middle image instructions?
Disconnect accelerator cable (1) and cruise control cable (2).
In the top right image (14.88), what should be done with hose clamp 1?
Loosen hose clamp (1) and pull off hose. Unscrew nuts and take off intake manifold.
In the middle right image showing the coolant expansion tank, what are callouts 1, 2, and 3?
The callouts indicate hose clamps (1 and 2) that should be loosened to pull off hoses on the coolant expansion tank, and nut (3) to take off the ground strap.
In the bottom right image, what components are indicated by callouts 1, 2, 3, and 4?
Callouts indicate plugs (1 and 2), vacuum hose (3) of pressure regulator, and screw (4) to take off lead with holder.
What should be done with the battery and splash guard at the beginning of the removal procedure?
Disconnect battery ground lead and remove splash guard.
What engine is shown in this cutaway diagram?
This is the BMW M3 Engine S 14 Z, as indicated by the caption at the bottom of the page.
What type of diagram is this showing the S14Z engine?
This is a detailed cutaway or cross-sectional diagram showing the internal components and construction of the engine.
How is the intake system configured in this engine view?
The intake manifold is positioned on top of the engine, feeding into the cylinder head with individual runners visible for each cylinder.
What can you see of the crankshaft and connecting rod assembly?
The cutaway shows the crankshaft at the bottom of the engine block with connecting rods attached to pistons, demonstrating the internal moving parts of the engine.
Where is the oil pan located in this engine diagram?
The oil pan is shown at the very bottom of the engine assembly, beneath the crankshaft and engine block.
What page number is shown for this engine diagram?
This diagram appears on page 11-50 of the service manual.
What is the tightening torque specification for the oxygen sensor installation?
The tightening torque for the oxygen sensor is 50 Nm (36 ft. lbs.).
What should you do with the fuel pipes during injection tube removal?
Don't mix up pipes 2 and 3 when removing them from the injection tube.
What components need to be disconnected when removing the vacuum hose and plug?
You need to pull off the vacuum hose (1) and plug (2), lift out the rubber retainer (3), place the idle speed control aside, and disconnect the engine wire harness located behind on the holder.
Which special tool is required for camshaft removal?
Special Tool 11 3 030 (tray) is required to pull out the tappets and place them during camshaft removal.
What is the procedure for removing the fuel injector plug plate?
Pull off the plug plate on fuel injectors and place it aside past the pressure regulator.
What should be done with the tappets during installation?
Install the tappets in the same position during installation.
How do you remove the radiator hoses?
Loosen the hose clamps and pull off the radiator hoses.
What components are numbered 1, 2, and 3 in the bleeder hose removal diagram?
Component 1 is the clamp to loosen, components 2 and 3 are the fuel pipes on the injection tube that should not be mixed up, and component 4 is the heater hose on the cylinder head.
What is the purpose of the longer bolt during installation?
The longer bolt (1) is used to lock the shaft for the upper tensioning rail during installation.
What should be loosened and pulled off from the cylinder head?
Loosen clamp (1) and pull off the bleeder hose, unscrew fuel pipes (2 and 3) on injection tube, and disconnect heater hose (4) on cylinder head.
What Loctite number should be used when installing the guide tube for the oil dipstick?
Loctite No. 270 should be used when installing the guide tube for the oil dipstick.
How should the guide tube be installed for the oil dipstick replacement?
Install guide tube with Loctite No. 270 and drive in against the stop.
What is the first step when removing the water pump?
The first step is to drain coolant. If applicable, remove fan cowl and fan - see 11 52 000.
What should be removed after draining the coolant during water pump removal?
Take off drive belt and remove pulley.
What special tool is required during water pump installation?
Special Tool 11 5 020 is required to check tightness during installation.
What should be done to the hose clamps during water pump removal?
Loosen hose clamps before removing the water pump.
What component needs to be replaced during water pump installation?
Replace gasket during installation.
What should be added during water pump installation?
Add coolant during installation.
What procedure code covers removing and installing the water pump?
Procedure code 11 51 000 covers removing and installing the water pump.
What procedure code covers replacing the guide tube for oil dipstick?
Procedure code 11 43 101 covers replacing the guide tube for oil dipstick.
What should be done with the drive belt and pulley setup when checking tightness?
Tighten drive belt and check tightness with Special Tool 11 5 020.
Where can additional service information be found according to the footnote?
Additional service information can be found in Service Information of Gr. 00.
What tool is used to lift out the radial oil seal from the timing case cover?
A screwdriver is used to lift out the radial oil seal.
What special tools are needed to press in the radial oil seal flush?
Special Tools 11 1 273 and 11 1 271 are needed to press in the radial oil seal flush.
What is the first step when replacing the radial oil seal in the clutch end cover?
Remove the flywheel (see 11 22 000) and drain the engine oil.
How should the gasket area of the end cover/oil pan joint be loosened?
Loosen the gasket in the area of the end cover/oil pan joint carefully with a knife.
What special tool is mentioned for pressing in the radial oil seal in the clutch end cover?
Special Tools 11 1 260 and 00 5 500 are used to press in the radial oil seal.
What is the offset measurement range for the new radial oil seal installation?
The new radial oil seal should be pressed in with approximately 1 to 2 mm (0.039 to 0.079 inch) offset toward the inside.
What sealant should be used on the end cover/oil pan joint?
Three Bond Silicone 1207** should be used to coat the end cover/oil pan joint.
Which special tool should be used to avoid damaging the radial oil seal during installation?
Special Tool 11 2 213 should be used to avoid damaging the radial oil seal.
What should be done to the oil pan during the clutch end cover radial oil seal replacement?
Loosen the oil pan and remove the oil pan gasket if it was damaged (see 11 13 000).
What procedure number should be referenced for removing the pulley on the crankshaft?
See procedure 11 21 120 for removing the pulley on the crankshaft.
What should be done after pressing in the new radial oil seal in the clutch end cover?
Lubricate the sealing lip with oil after pressing in the new radial oil seal.
What should you do with the electric leads on the starter before unscrewing the cover?
Disconnect electric leads 2 and 3 on the starter before unscrewing cover 1.
How do you remove the oil plugs and electric leads from the oil pan area?
Pull off plugs 1 and 2 and unclip electric leads in holders. Then remove electric lead 3 on oil pan, pull off plug and unscrew holder, and take out lead from above.
Which hoses need to be disconnected from the injection pipe?
Loosen clamp 1 and pull off breather hose, then disconnect fuel hoses 2 and 3 on the injection pipe.
What is the installation note regarding hoses 2 and 3?
Don't mix up hoses 2 and 3 during installation.
How do you handle the engine wire harness during removal?
Loosen clamp 1 and place engine wire harness aside, then loosen hose clamp 2 and pull off heater hose.
What is the procedure for removing the vacuum hose from the intake manifold support?
Pull off vacuum hose 1 and pull it out of the intake manifold support, then pull off plug 2.
What should be done with the idle speed control after lifting out the rubber holder?
Lift out rubber holder 3, place idle speed control aside and take the engine wire harness located behind it out of the holders.
How should the carbon filter be positioned when loosening the clamp?
Loosen clamp and place carbon filter aside, with hoses remaining connected.
What components are numbered 1, 2, and 3 in the starter area diagram?
Component 1 is the cover to unscrew, while components 2 and 3 are the electric leads to disconnect on the starter.
Which heater hose needs to be disconnected and where is it located?
Disconnect heater hose 4 on cylinder head after loosening the clamp.
What chapter section is this page from?
This page is from Chapter 11 Engine.
Which engine models are covered in this section?
This section covers the Engine M3 / 320is models.
What page number contains the engine view information?
The engine view information is found on page 11-100.
On which page can I find the compression check procedure for all cylinders?
The compression of all cylinders check procedure is on page 11-101.

The two oil pan sections are the oil pan upper section and oil pan lower section, both with remove and install procedures.

Cylinder head removal and installation is covered on page 11-106.

What is the nominal value for cam distance 'N'?
What tightening torque should be used for the timing chain sprocket bolts?
How should the timing chain be positioned when mounting it on the intake side sprocket?
Tighten the timing chain in opposite direction of engine rotation and mount on the intake side sprocket 'I' first.
What installation sequence should be followed for the exhaust side sprocket?
Install exhaust side sprocket 'A', install adapter (1), install lockplate and bolt down the sprocket with the specified torque of 9 + 1 Nm (6.5 + 0.5 ft. lbs.).
What adjustment is mentioned for sprocket mounting bolts?
Lock sprocket mounting bolts with a lockplate. Adjust valve clearance - see 11 31 020.
Where should you refer for chain tensioner installation?
What timing verification steps are specified after installation?
Turn engine once in direction of rotation and recheck the timing. Check crankshaft at TDC, one each camshaft groove faces in, one each camshaft groove faces out, and bearing cap positioning.
What components are labeled 'A' and 'E' in the installation diagram?
A indicates the exhaust side sprocket and E indicates another component in the timing chain assembly.
How should camshaft bearing caps be installed according to the lettering?
Install camshaft bearing caps on timing case according to lettering.
What timing positions should the camshaft grooves be in when checking timing?
One each camshaft groove faces in, one each camshaft groove faces out, with bearing cap on bearing cap.
What is the tightening torque specification for the distributor rotor adapter?
The tightening torque for the distributor rotor adapter is 23 ± 1 Nm (16.5 ± 0.5 ft. lbs.).
What is the camshaft timing specification shown in the valve timing data?
The camshaft timing is specified as 248°.
What diameter is specified for the intake valve?
The intake valve diameter is 37 mm (1.457 inches).
What should be checked when removing the distributor housing and plugs?
Check O-rings, replacing if necessary.
What is the first step shown for removing the camshaft?
Remove cylinder head cover (see section 11 12 000), then unscrew bolts (1 through 3) and take off distributor cap.
What components are numbered 4 and 5 in the valve timing diagram?
Component 4 is the Dowel pin and component 5 is the Sprocket - intake 'E'.
What is the length specification for the valve spring inside measurement?
The valve spring inside length is 38.5 mm (1.516 inches) long.
What tool specification is given for the hexagon head screw?
The hexagon head screw is specified as M 6 x 16.
What range is specified for the shims in the valve timing components?
Shims are available from 3.00 to 4.25 mm (0.118 to 0.167 inches).
What should be done when replacing the end cover gasket?
Replace gasket and use longer bolts in bores with a dowel sleeve.
What is the exhaust valve diameter specification?
The exhaust valve diameter is 32 mm (1.260 inches).
What components are identified as numbers 1, 2, and 3 in the camshaft removal procedure?
These numbers refer to the bolts that must be unscrewed to remove the distributor cap during camshaft removal.
What is the specified tightening torque for M7 bolts during installation?
M7 bolts should be tightened to 15 + 2 Nm (11 + 1.4 ft. lbs.).
What is the specified cam follower play installed distance?
The cam follower play installed distance should be 0.005 to 0.008 mm (0.0001 to 0.0026").
What procedure should be followed when replacing O-rings in oil bore?
Replace O-ring (2) in oil bore, check O-rings (3), replacing if necessary, then coat sealing surfaces with Three Bond 1207.
What is the three-step tightening sequence for cylinder head bolts?
Step 1 = 50 + 2 Nm (36 + 1.4 ft. lbs.), Step 2 = 80 + 2 Nm (58 + 1.4 ft. lbs.), Step 3 = 100 + 2 Nm (72 + 1.4 ft. lbs.) with a 15-minute wait between steps 2 and 3.
What should be checked when measuring cam follower play?
Set internal calipers to zero on the micrometer with the measured cam follower diameter, measure diameter of cam follower bore, and compare measured cam follower play with specified play.
What tool is needed to check cam follower levelness?
A standard steel ruler is needed to check levelness.
What is the proper sequence for removing cylinder head bolts?
Unscrew cylinder head bolts in order of 10 through 1 and lift off cylinder head.
What cleaning procedure should be followed for cylinder head bolt cavities?
Clean cavities in crankcase/cylinder head bolts and lubricate cylinder head bolts with oil.
What callout numbers are shown on the cylinder head bolt diagram?
The cylinder head bolt diagram shows callout numbers 1 through 10, indicating the bolt removal sequence.
What is specified as the source of supply for this procedure?
The source of supply is specified as HWB.
What should you do with the cover on the starter before disconnecting leads?
Unscrew cover (1), then disconnect leads (2 and 3) on starter.
What components are numbered 1, 2, and 3 in the first image showing starter removal?
Component 1 is the cover to unscrew, components 2 and 3 are the leads to disconnect on the starter.
What is the correct procedure for removing plugs 1 and 2 from the oil pan area?
Pull off plugs (1 and 2) and unclip leads in holder. Disconnect lead (3) on oil pan (pull off plug and unscrew holder) and remove lead from above.
What specific instruction is given about the fuel pipes during installation?
Don't mix up pipes (2 and 3) during installation.
What components need to be loosened or removed to access the bleeder hose?
Loosen clamp (1) and pull off bleeder hose. Unscrew fuel pipes (2 and 3) on injection pipe. Disconnect heater hose (4) on cylinder head.
What is the procedure for removing the intake manifold brace?

Pull off vacuum hose (1) and pull out of intake manifold brace. Pull off plug (2). Lift out rubber retainer (3). Place idle speed control aside and take engine wire harness located behind out of holders.
What should you do with the carbon canister hoses?
Loosen clamp and place carbon canister aside (hoses can remain connected).
What is shown being removed from the fuel injectors in the top right image?
Pull off plug plate on fuel injectors and lay aside past the pressure regulator.
What components are labeled 1, 2, and 3 in the image showing fuel pipe removal?
Component 1 is the clamp to loosen, components 2 and 3 are the fuel pipes to unscrew on the injection pipe.
What is the specific instruction about the heater hose clamp?
Loosen hose clamp (2) and pull off heater hose.
What special tool is required to disconnect the support and gas pressure prop for the engine hood?
Special Tool 51 2 120.
What should be done before removing the fan during oil cooler hose disconnection?
Remove fan - see Gr. 17.
Which special tool is needed to tighten the drive belt for both the power steering pump and air conditioner compressor?
Special Tool 11 5 021.
What precaution is mentioned when using the retainer during engine hood support disconnection?
Use retainer (1). Caution!
How should the power steering pump be suspended after unscrewing it from the holder?
Suspend it from car aside with a piece of wire, keeping hydraulic hoses connected.
What should remain connected when removing the air conditioner compressor from its holder?
Refrigerant hoses should remain connected.
What are the two positions for unscrewing engine mounts on the front axle carrier?
Left - unscrew at top, loosen at bottom; right - loosen at top, unscrew at bottom.
What component is labeled as item 2 in the engine hood support diagram?
The plastic part that should be inserted during installation.
How should both the power steering pump and air conditioner compressor be positioned after removal?
Both should be suspended from the car aside with a piece of wire while keeping their respective hoses connected.
What page can I find information about replacing the connecting rod on the BMW M3 S14Z engine?
Information about connecting rod replacement (piston removal) can be found on page 11-64.
Where in the manual would I look to find procedures for timing chain replacement?
Timing chain replacement procedures are located on page 11-70.
What is the procedure number for valve clearance adjustment on the S14Z engine?
The procedure number for valve clearance adjustment is 11 34 004.
On which page can I find the oil pump removal and installation procedure?
Oil pump removal and installation procedures are on page 11-75.
What procedure number corresponds to coolant thermostat removal and installation?
Coolant thermostat removal and installation has procedure number 11 53 000.
Where would I find information about checking engine oil pressure?
Engine oil pressure check information can be found on page 11-75, under procedure 11 40 000.
What is the specified tappet clearance range for installation?
The tappet clearance/installed clearance is 0.0025 to 0.066 mm (0.0001 to 0.0026 inches).
What are the three tightening torque steps for cylinder head bolts and what are their values?
Step 1: 50 + 2 Nm (36 + 1 ft. lbs.), Step 2: 80 + 2 Nm (58 + 1 ft. lbs.), Step 3: 100 + 2 Nm (72 + 1 ft. lbs.). Wait 15 minutes between steps.
What torque specifications are given for M7 and M8 bolts during installation?
In what order should cylinder head bolts be unscrewed and tightened?
Unscrew cylinder head bolts in order of 10 to 1 and lift off the cylinder head. Tighten bolts in order of 1 to 10 in three steps.
What cleaning procedure is specified for the crankcase and cylinder head bolt holes?

Clean holes in crankcase and cylinder head bolts, lubricate cylinder head bolts with oil, and clean sealing surfaces on cylinder head and crankcase thoroughly using a gasket remover and hard wood scraper.
How should tappet clearance be measured according to the instructions?
Set internal calipers to zero on the micrometer with the measured tappet diameter, measure tappet bore diameter, and compare measured tappet clearance with the specified clearance.
What tool is specified for measuring tappet diameter?
A micrometer should be used to measure tappet diameter.
What should be checked during cylinder head installation?
Check levelness with a standard steel ruler, replace cylinder head gasket, and check arrangement of tensioning rails while mounting the cylinder head.
What components are shown being removed in the timing case removal diagram?
The diagram shows removal of pipe (2) and unscrewing bolt (3), followed by removing the timing case.
What is the numbered sequence shown in the cylinder head bolt tightening diagram?
The diagram shows bolts numbered 1 through 10, indicating the proper sequence for tightening cylinder head bolts.
What installation step involves O-ring replacement?
Replace O-ring (2) in oil bore and check O-rings if replacement is necessary during installation.
What is the important requirement when installing connecting rods?
Only install connecting rods of same weight class in one engine. Weight class is shown on the connecting rod by a certain number and color of paint dots.
Can connecting rods be machined?
Connecting rods may not be machined.
How should the piston pin slide through the conrod bushing?
Piston pin must slide through the conrod bushing under light pressure.
What are the two bearing shell installation options for the connecting rod and conrod cap?
Install one each yellow bearing shell in connecting rod and conrod cap, or one blue bearing shell in connecting rod and one red bearing shell in conrod cap.
What should be checked regarding the conrod bearing diameter?
Check the machined size (conrod bearing dia.).
What type of Plastigage should be placed on the conrod bearing journal?
Place Type PG-1 Plastigage on conrod bearing journal wiped clean of oil in BDC position.
What type of conrod bolts should be used when tightening?
Use old conrod bolts. Don't turn the crankshaft.
How should bearing play be corrected if it's not within specification?
Correct bearing play by installing new bearing shells or bearing shells with different machined size or different color code.
What is the nominal valve clearance specification for cold conditions?
The nominal valve clearance for cold conditions is 0.26 to 0.35 mm (0.010 to 0.014 inches).
What special tool is required to crank the engine during valve adjustment?
Special Tool 11 3 020 is required to crank the engine during valve adjustment.
How do you remove the valve shim for adjustment?
Blow out the valve shim with compressed air to remove it.
What should you do if the measured valve clearance is not within specified tolerances?
Turn openings of tappets as shown in the picture if the measured valve clearance is not within specified tolerances.
What special tool is shown in the diagram for adjusting tappets?
Special Tool 11 3 170 is shown in the diagram for guiding and adjusting the tappets.
How should the valve shim be installed after measuring its thickness?
Install the shim of required thickness with the lettering facing down.
What must remain in place when checking valves for leaks?
Spark plugs remain screwed in when checking valves for leaks with the cylinder head removed.
What should be filled in the combustion chamber during valve leak testing?
Fill the combustion chamber with gasoline outdoors or indoors with conformance of fire prevention regulations.
What components must be inspected if gasoline runs past the valve heads during leak testing?
Valves and valve seats must be inspected if gasoline runs past the valve heads during leak testing.
Where can you find instructions for removing valves?
Instructions for removing valves can be found in section 11 34 550.
Where can you find information about machining valve seats?
Information about machining valve seats can be found in section 11 12 607.
What does pin 1 connect to on Control Unit M 1.1?
Pin 1 connects to Ignition term. 1.
Which pin number is used for the Interface ASC connection?
Pin 2 is used for the Interface ASC (S - ASC / S - DWA) connection.
What does LMM stand for in the explanations?
LMM stands for Air flow sensor.
Which pin carries the oxygen sensor signal?
Pin 9 carries the oxygen sensor signal.
What is the function of pin 14?
Pin 14 is used for Ground fuel injectors.
What does MSR represent in the abbreviations?
MSR represents Engine drag torque control.
Which pin number handles the speedometer signal from instrument cluster?
Pin 10 handles the speedometer signal from instrument cluster.
What is connected to pin 16?
Pin 16 is connected to Fuel injector group 2 (cyl. 1, 3, 5).
What does EKP stand for according to the explanations?
EKP stands for Electric fuel pump.
Which pin is used for the transmission tap connection?
Pin 15 is used for the transmission tap (S - GE) connection.
What are the three relays shown in the bottom left image used for?
Relay 1 for fuel pump, Relay 2 for DME, and Relay 3 for oxygen sensor heating.
What temperature switch is identified as component 4 in the top right image?
Temperature time switch.
What are the wire colors for the air conditioner plug?
Blue/white wire colors.
What does component 1 represent in the engine bay according to the top right image?
Temperature switch with 45° C (113° F) for idle speed control.
What sensors are connected to plugs B and D in the bottom right image?
Plug for (gray) reference mark sensor (B) and speed sensor (D).
According to the middle left image, what is the temperature specification for the idle speed control switch?
Switch 0° C (32° F) for idle speed control.
What voltage should be measured on pin 18 to ground for the battery positive supply?
The voltage should measure approximately 12 V.
What should I check if the voltage on pin 18 is low?
Check battery and lead via relay 2 (master relay) to control unit.
What voltage should pin 37 show with ignition ON?
Pin 37 should measure voltage greater than 10 V with ignition ON.
What corrective action should be taken if pin 37 voltage is too low?
Check/repair relay 2 (master relay) and electronics ground point.
How do I test the ground supply connections for the control unit?
Measure resistance against battery negative or ground on pins 2, 14, 19, 24 and body ground. Resistance should be less than 1 ohm.
What is the correct resistance specification for the inductive pulse sender?
The resistance should be 540 ohms ± 10%.
How should I test the inductive pulse sender signal?
Check speed signal (one signal for each revolution) with an oscilloscope.
What should I do if the pulse sender resistance is out of specification?
Repair leads, replacing pulse sender if necessary.
How do I test the fuel pump relay activation signal?
Check speed signal with oscilloscope on pin 3 to ground.
What should I replace if the pulse sender tests okay but there's still no speed signal?
If pulse sender (pins 47/48) is okay, replace DME control unit.
What lubricant should be applied to the guiding sleeve of Special Tool 12 1 092?
Spray a thin coat of lubricant 12 1 098 on the guiding sleeve of Special Tool 12 1 092.
How much wire should be stripped from the ignition lead end using stripping pliers?
Strip ignition lead end by 6 mm with a stripping pliers (1.5 mm wire cross section size).
What is the minimum tear-out force required for the ignition lead test?
Perform tear-out test by hand (tearing-out force: ≥ 200 N / 44 lbs.).
What happens if you open the pliers too much during the connector installation?
Opening the pliers too much could cause the plug receptacle to break. The plug receptacle is shown cut open for better demonstration.
How should the ignition lead be positioned after unscrewing the screw?
Slide in ignition lead against stop, then follow with pliers and slide in ignition lead further until connector is heard to engage.
What should be done to the clamping jaws when placing the connector in the special tool?
Move clamping jaws together by turning screw against stop.
How much should the screw be tightened when using the pliers?
Tighten screw enough, that the pliers can be pulled back.
What procedure applies to the non-disconnectable version of the 30 kV system?
For the non-disconnectable version 30 kV system, cut off ignition lead as shown.
What alternative tool set is available for this spark plug connector replacement?
The required special tools 12 1 091/092/098 are also available as a complete set 12 1 090.
What should be done after squeezing the clamping jaws?
After squeezing, release jaws and take out the ignition lead.
What is the section number and title for this spark plug connector replacement procedure?
This is section 12 12 072 titled 'REPLACING ONE SPARK PLUG CONNECTOR'.
What are the wire colors and sizes for terminal 2 on the Master Relay M20?
Terminal 2 on the Master Relay M20 uses terminal 87 with red/white wire color and a size of 0.75/4 mm².
Which terminal number corresponds to the brown wire on the Master Relay M20?
Terminal number 85 corresponds to the brown wire on the Master Relay M20, with a wire size of 0.5 mm².
What wire color and size is used for terminal 6 on the Fuel Pump Relay M20?
Terminal 6 on the Fuel Pump Relay M20 uses terminal 30 with a red wire color and a size of 1.5 mm².
What are the terminal assignments for the green/violet wire on the Fuel Pump Relay?
The green/violet wire on the Fuel Pump Relay is assigned to jack number 2, terminal number 87, with a wire size of 1.5/1 mm².
Which relay uses a green/blue wire color, and what is its wire size?
The Oxygen Sensor Relay M20 uses a green/blue wire color on terminal 87 (jack 2) with a wire size of 0.5 mm².
What is the terminal number for jack 8 on all the relay sockets shown?
Jack 8 on all the relay sockets shown corresponds to terminal number 86.
What wire color is used for terminal 30 across all three relays?
Red wire color is used for terminal 30 across all three relays shown.
What is the largest wire size specification shown for the Oxygen Sensor Relay?
The largest wire size specification for the Oxygen Sensor Relay is 1/0.5 mm² for the green/white wire on terminal 30 (jack 6).
Which terminal position uses brown/green wire color and what is its size?
The brown/green wire color is used on terminal 85 (jack 4) of the Fuel Pump Relay and Oxygen Sensor Relay, with a size of 0.5 mm².
What is Test 7 focused on testing?
Test 7 is focused on testing ignition timing and ignition timing control.
What should you do if the engine does not run after checking ignition timing?
Check the position of the distributor - move piston in cylinder no. 1 to ignition position; mark on distributor housing must be aligned with contact on distributor rotor - see 12 11 060.
Where should you look for ignition timing adjustment procedures if necessary?
See section 12 11 005 for ignition timing adjustment procedures.
If the engine still does not run after the initial timing check, what should be checked next?
Check fuel supply - see Groups 13 and 16, and check engine for mechanical defect - see Group 11.
What specific ignition timing control tests are mentioned in the procedure?
Check ignition timing control with centrifugal force and vacuum (P 07 / 08), and check ignition voltage (P 09), repeating tests 3, 5 and 6 if necessary.
What should be done if the distributor needs repair or replacement?
Repair or replace distributor if necessary - see 12 11.
What does P 06 refer to in the ignition timing procedure?
P 06 refers to checking ignition timing, adjusting if necessary.
What specific tests need to be repeated if ignition voltage check (P 09) shows problems?
Tests 3, 5 and 6 need to be repeated if necessary.
What are the two types of ignition timing control that need to be checked?
Centrifugal force and vacuum control need to be checked (P 07 / 08).
What section should you refer to for distributor repair or replacement procedures?
Section 12 11 for distributor repair or replacement procedures.
What is component number 1 in the Engine Electrical Layout for Model 318i?
Component number 1 is the Control unit - L-Jetronic (see Gr. 13).
What are the wire colors for the transmission versions plug (white)?
The wire colors for the transmission versions plug (white) are green/yellow - blue/yellow, and it is not used for automatics (lean mixture) but connected for manuals.
What does component number 6 represent in the TCI-S control unit image?
Component number 6 is the TCI-S control unit.
What is the purpose of the black plug identified as component 5?
The black plug (component 5) is for air conditioner with wire colors black/white.
What three types of relays are shown in the relay assembly at the bottom left?
The three relays are: 1) Relay for fuel injection, fuel pump, oxygen sensor heating, 2) Relay for idle speed stabilization (see Group 13), and 3) Relay for ignition switchover.
What is component 7 in the TCI-S control unit assembly?
Component 7 is the Solenoid valve for ignition switchover.
What sensor is shown in the bottom right image with reference number 30 12 158?
The Air temperature sensor for ignition switchover is shown in the bottom right image.
What are the wire colors for the control unit coding plug (red)?
The wire colors for the control unit coding plug (red) are brown/violet.
What should you do before assembling the starter components?
Clean all components thoroughly prior to assembling.
What reference should you see for removing the solenoid?
How do you prevent carbon brushes from popping out during installation?
Insert a 22 mm wrench socket or a pipe with an outside diameter of approx. 30 mm (1.181").
What are the numbered components shown in the motor and gearbox separation diagram?
1 is the motor, 2 is the gearbox, 3 is a groove component, and 4 is the rubber part that must be aligned with groove 3.
What alignment requirement is specified when separating the motor and gearbox?
Groove 3 must be aligned with rubber part 4.
What should you inspect on the armature shaft during disassembly?
Inspect armature shaft, removing burrs if necessary.
What components should you remove when taking off the cap according to reference M 21 12 040?
Take off retainer 1 and shims 2.
What should you check during installation after removing the cap and retainer?
Check axial play, correcting if necessary.
What tool is recommended to make installation easier when mounting the unit?
Use wrench socket or pipe again to make installation easier.
What should you unscrew when starting the layshaft removal process?
Unscrew heat shield (if applicable), unscrew bracket, and check spacers.
What components should be removed according to reference M 21 12 046?
Take off cover and rubber pad.
What are the testing requirements before troubleshooting the TCI system?
Battery charged (voltage > 12 V), specified fuel in tank (octane rating lead content), and ambient temperature approx 20° C (68° F); considerable deviation would change the measured values.
What symptoms indicate faults in the TCI system?
Engine not starting running incorrectly, misfiring in different operating conditions, and poor engine output.
What page should I refer to for instructions on working with TCI and DME?
Page 12-0.
What is the first step in Test 1 for the pulse sensor in distributor?
Crank engine with starter and check pulse sensor voltage using multimeter M 02.
What should I do if the pulse sensor voltage is not okay during cranking?
Check pulse sensor resistance on disconnected control unit plug M 06 - see 12 11 150.
If the pulse sensor resistance check is not okay, what is the next step?
Replace pulse sensor - see 12 11 151.
What should I do if the pulse sensor resistance is okay but voltage was not okay?
Disconnect pulse sensor wire on distributor and on control unit - check power flow and ground out.
If the power flow and ground check is okay, what should be replaced?
Replace pulse sensor - see 12 11 151.
What BMW service test procedures are referenced for testing instructions?
Engine test/test step 05 (P 05) or multimeter 02 (M 02), and connections should be made according to operating instructions.
What are the numbered components shown in image 30 12 015?
The numbered components are: (1) plug, (2) clamps, and (3) clamps that need to be removed from the distributor cap.
What should be done after loosening the nut shown in image 30 12 017?
After loosening the nut, pull out the distributor.
What should be checked during installation according to image 30 12 019?
Check seal (1), replacing if necessary during installation.
How should the distributor rotor be positioned during installation?
Turn distributor rotor clockwise toward mark on housing approx. 30° (A), then insert distributor.
What needs to be checked regarding the distributor rotor position?
Check position of distributor rotor - it should point to notch on distributor. Correct by turning crankshaft, if necessary.
What is the first step in removing the distributor cap?
Take off cap (1).
What procedure should be followed after finishing the distributor installation?
Adjust ignition timing (see 12 11 005) after finishing installation.
What is the sequence for removing components from the distributor cap?
First pull off plug (1), then lift off clamps (2 and 3), and finally remove distributor cap.
What reference section should be consulted for ignition timing adjustment?
Section 12 11 005 should be consulted for ignition timing adjustment procedures.
What is the BMW part reference number for this distributor removal and installation procedure?
The BMW part reference number is 12 11 060.
What is the minimum diameter specification for the commutator?
The diameter must be at least 33.5 mm (1.319").
What depth should the insulation be machined to between commutator plates?
Machine insulation between plates approximately 0.5 to 0.7 mm (0.020 to 0.027") deep.
What should you check for after machining the commutator insulation?
Check for shorted turns after machining.
What is the proper way to install new carbon brushes?
When soldering in new carbon brushes, make sure that copper leads are not hardened with flowing solder.
How do you remove the carbon brush holder?
Slide carbon brush holder to center and lift off.
What should be done to the commutator surface during service?
Fine grind and polish commutator. File or machine insulation between commutator plates to depth of 0.5 to 0.7 mm (0.020 to 0.027").
How should the carbon brush holder be installed?
Engage hooks of carbon brush holder completely.
What must be done with the carbon brushes during installation?
Two carbon brushes must be cut off of the leads. Solder in new carbon brushes.
What components need to be removed to access the carbon brushes?
Take off holder and pole housing. Unsolder or cut off all carbon brushes.
What inspection should be performed on the commutator?
Check commutator for wear, fine grinding if necessary.
What section number covers replacing carbon brushes?
Section 12 41 551 covers replacing carbon brushes for both starter removed/disassembled and starter and layshaft disassembled procedures.
If the starter does not work at all, what should I check first?

Bridge connection 30 with connection 50 on solenoid. If starter works, check for defective wires and connections on starter switch or starter switch defective. If starter does not work, turn on lights to further diagnose.
What causes a starter to turn too slowly?
A) Bearings worn or very dirty, or B) Electrical defect in solenoid, armature or coils.
If the starter slips, what component should I inspect?

Check gear ring teeth on flywheel. If teeth are damaged, remove transmission and replace flywheel. If teeth are okay, repair the starter by checking the drive pinion (one-way clutch) and engaging mechanism.
What does it indicate if I only hear a click in the solenoid when trying to start?
Turn on lights to diagnose further. If lights go out while starting, there's a short in starter. If lights remain on while starting, check for carbon brushes worn or solenoid defective.
What should I do if the lights go out while attempting to start the engine?
This indicates a short in the starter, which needs to be repaired or replaced.
How do I test if the starter solenoid is working properly?
Bridge connection 30 with connection 50 on solenoid. If the starter works with this bridge, the solenoid connections are good and the problem is likely in the starter switch or its wiring.
What are the possible causes if lights remain on while starting but the starter doesn't turn?
A) Carbon brushes worn, or B) Solenoid defective.
If the flywheel gear ring teeth are damaged, what repair is required?
Remove transmission and replace flywheel.
What starter components should be checked if the gear ring teeth are okay but the starter still slips?
A) Drive pinion (one-way clutch) and B) Engaging mechanism.
What should be checked on the distributor cap and rotor during Test 4?
Check distributor cap and rotor for correct fit, damage and hairline cracks as well as signs of burning.
What reference should be consulted when checking wire connections for oxidation and good contact?
What should the resistance be from distributor peak to corresponding contact in distributor cap?
Resistance must be approximately 0 ohm.
What multimeter setting is used to check distributor rotor resistance?
Check resistance (M 06) of distributor rotor.
What is the title of Test 5?
IGNITION LEADS AND LEAD CONNECTORS.
What should be checked on spark plug connectors and shielded connectors?
Check spark plug connectors and shielded connectors for damage, tightness and good contact.
How should ignition leads be handled during inspection to check for cracks?
Bend ignition leads in a tight radius and check for cracks.
What test method is specified for checking spark plug connectors and ignition leads?
Check resistance (M 06) of spark plug connectors and ignition leads.
What component is shown being removed or inspected in the diagram?
The diagram shows the distributor cap being removed or inspected, revealing the internal rotor and contacts.
Where can specifications for the resistance measurements be found?
See Specifications.
What is the expected resistance reading when checking from distributor peak to distributor cap contact?
The resistance must be approximately 0 ohm, indicating a good electrical connection.
What are the test requirements before troubleshooting the alternator?
Correct connections on battery, starter and alternator; good ground connection between engine and body; and tight drive belt.
What should I do if the charge indicator lamp is NOT on with ignition turned on?

Pull off connection plug D+/61 and connect with ground (term. 31). If charge lamp comes on, take off voltage regulator and check carbon brushes, replacing if necessary - see 12 32 000. Check slip rings for dirt or oxidation coat. If charge lamp still doesn't come on, check connections and wires for charge indicator lamp or replace light bulb - see 62 99.
What is the first step when the charge indicator lamp is ON with ignition off?
Remove alternator and replace diode plate - see 12 31 691.
What should be done if the regulating voltage is not okay during testing?
Replace voltage regulator - see 12 32 000.
If the oscillograph and harmonic wave ratio check is not okay, what is the corrective action?
Replace or disassemble alternator and inspect components.
When the battery is charged insufficiently with charge indicator lamp off during engine running, what is the first diagnostic step?
Connect BMW service test unit and perform engine test (P 02).
What should be checked if the battery needs replacement during insufficient charging diagnosis?
Check battery, replacing if necessary. Check power drain with equipment switched off.
If the charging current with equipment is too low, what are the possible solutions?
