What critical installation check is mentioned for the BMW M3 clutch housing procedure?
Check installed position. Plugs must not be mixed up.
What happens if plugs are mixed up during BMW M3 clutch housing installation?
Engine cannot be started, if plugs are mixed up.
What should be checked during installation of the sensors?
Check O-rings and install sensors with Molykote Longterm 2.
What important condition must be met for DME senders during installation?
Face surface of DME senders must be free of grease and dirt.
What tool is specified for unscrewing Torx bolts when removing the position sender?
Use a Torx wrench to unscrew Torx bolts.
What installation requirement is specified for the Torx bolts to prevent breaking-loose torque issues?
Torx bolts must be installed with washers to avoid an increase in breaking-loose torque.
What are the two main procedures described in section 21 52 000?
Removing and installing clutch master cylinder, which includes disconnecting the pipe to slave cylinder.
What should you do with the brake fluid tank before removing the clutch master cylinder?
Unscrew cap on brake fluid tank, remove float container, and draw off brake fluid in tank to lower level to connection for the filling pipe.
What components are labeled with numbers 4, 5, and 6 in the top right diagram?
Number 4 is the filling pipe to pull out, numbers 5 and 6 are bolts to unscrew for removing the master cylinder.
What diameter slave cylinder is required for dual-mass flywheel versions?
A slave cylinder with a diameter of 22.2 mm (0.874 inches), instead of 20.64 mm (0.809 inches), must be installed for the version with a double mass flywheel.
How do you remove the instrument panel trim for clutch pedal access?
Remove instrument panel trim at bottom left and disconnect piston rod on the clutch pedal.
What cross-reference is provided for bleeding the clutch system?
Bleed clutch - see 21 00 006.
What important installation note is given regarding the over-center spring?
Engage over-center spring in guide tab on the pedal base prior to installation of the piston rod.
What components are shown in the bottom diagram numbered 8 and 9?
Number 8 is the over-center spring and number 9 is the guide tab on the pedal base where the spring must be engaged.
What is the procedure for removing the clutch slave cylinder?
Unscrew slave cylinder on transmission, remove slave cylinder, and disconnect pipe.
What orientation should the bleeder screw have during installation?
Bleeder screw faces down, and install front push rod with Molykote Long-term 2.
Why is a larger diameter slave cylinder needed for dual-mass flywheel applications?
To avoid contact of the release lever when the clutch pedal is floored, as referenced in Service Information of Group 21.
What should you visually inspect the clutch for during inspection?
Visually inspect clutch for cracks, wear and burnt spots.
What condition must the pressure contact surface be in?
Pressure contact surface must be level.
What should you inspect the clutch rivets for?
Visually inspect clutch rivets for wear and tight fit.
What should you do if the clutch has loose or worn rivets?
Replace a clutch with loose or worn rivets.
What important step should you take when installing a new clutch disc?
Remove all corrosion inhibitor when installing a new clutch disc.
How does the clutch for the double mass flywheel version differ?
The clutch for the version with a double mass flywheel is lower in height.
How should you position the clutch disc during installation?
Place clutch disc over dowel pins.
How should you tighten the mounting bolts?
Tighten mounting bolts separately and uniformly to specified torque.
What does callout number 3 identify in the clutch assembly diagram?
Callout number 3 identifies the flywheel.
What components are identified by callout numbers 4 and 5 in the clutch assembly?
Callout number 4 identifies the drive plate and callout number 5 identifies the thrust plate.
Where can you find the source of supply information for certain components?
Source of Supply: HWB, and additional specifications can be found in the Specifications section.
What special tool is needed to hold the flywheel for Engine M20?
Special Tool 11 2 170 is needed to hold the flywheel for Engine M20.
What gap measurement indicates the drive plate must be replaced?
The drive plate is worn and must be replaced when there is a gap of 5 mm (0.197 inches) between Special Tool 21 2 060 and slave cylinder.
What should be checked on clutch liners before removing them?
Check clutch for wear before removing. Clutch liners are okay if Special Tool 21 2 060 can be pushed into opening of slave cylinder against stop.
How should the mounting bolts be loosened when removing the clutch?
Loosen mounting bolts separately 1 to 1 1/2 turns until clutch is relaxed.
What safety precaution is mentioned regarding clutch components?
Liners contain asbestos - conform with safety precautions (also refer to general information in Group 0).
What should you check on the drive plate during inspection?
Check drive plate for wear, cracks and torsion damper for tight fit of spring elements. Also check transmission end mark on drive plate.
What important warning is given about handling the clutch disc?
Don't throw or drop clutch disc - improper handling could bend off tangential leaf springs which hold clutch disc in turning direction.
What should be done to the grooved ball bearing in crankshaft during installation?
Check grooved ball bearing in crankshaft for easy movement, replacing if necessary.
What tool is used to center the drive plate in flywheel during installation?
Center drive plate in flywheel with Special Tool 21 2 100.
What should be checked at the tips of diaphragm springs?
Check deviation at tips of diaphragm springs.
What should you use to clean the clutch master cylinder and inside parts?
Clean master cylinder and inside parts with alcohol.
When should you replace the entire master cylinder?
Replace entire master cylinder if cylinder has scoring or corrosion.
What are the five components that make up the master cylinder repair kit?
The repair kit consists of: 1 Piston assembly, 2 Circlip, 3 Protective cap, 4 Sealing plug, 5 Spring.
What type of paste should be used to coat the cylinder bore and grooves?
Coat cylinder bore and grooves lightly with ATE brake cylinder paste.
What is the important note about repair kit compatibility for the master cylinder?
Only use repair kit of same make as pertinent master cylinder.
What procedure should be followed for cleaning the slave cylinder?
Clean slave cylinder and inside parts with alcohol.
When should the entire slave cylinder be replaced?
Replace entire slave cylinder if cylinder bore has scoring or corrosion.
What components are included in the slave cylinder repair kit?
The slave cylinder repair kit consists of: 1 Protective cap, 2 Grooved cup, Retaining ring, and Toothed ring.
What callout number 4 indicates in the master cylinder diagram?
Callout number 4 indicates the Sealing plug in the master cylinder assembly.
What callout numbers 1 and 2 represent in the slave cylinder diagram?
In the slave cylinder diagram, callout 1 indicates the Protective cap and callout 2 indicates the Grooved cup.
What is the critical compatibility requirement for slave cylinder repair kits?
Only use repair kit of same make as pertinent slave cylinder.
What is the dial gauge tolerance for checking drive plate lateral runout?
Apply dial gauge about 3 mm (0.118") from outer edge.
What lubricant should be used for coating guides and bearings during clutch release installation?
Coat guides (F) and bearings (L) with Molykote Longterm 2 lightly.
How should the drive plate be straightened if it shows lateral runout?
Straighten drive plate by applying knocks from a plastic hammer on take-up points of tester.
What component must be removed according to section 23 00 022 when working on clutch release?
Remove transmission - see 23 00 022.
Which tool numbers are required for checking drive plate lateral runout?
Clamp tester 21 2 110 in a vise and mount dial gage 00 2 510 and holder 00 2 500.
What should be done to prepare the drive plate tester before use?
Clamp drive plate on tester and clean liner with emery cloth.
What is packed with Molykote Longterm 2 during installation?
Pack lubricating groove (N) with Molykote Longterm 2.
What callout numbers identify the spring, lever, and release components in the removal diagram?
Spring (1), release lever (2), and release (3) are shown in the removal diagram.
What must be checked for height after clutch release installation?
Check height of release B* and C*.
What is the consequence of non-conformance mentioned in the installation notes?
Non-conformance could cause bearing to seize on guide sleeve.
What action should be taken after straightening the drive plate?
Repeat testing procedures after straightening the drive plate.
What letters identify the guides, bearings, and lubricating groove in the installation diagram?
F identifies guides, L identifies bearings, and N identifies the lubricating groove.
What components need to be pulled off when the output shaft is removed?
When the output shaft is removed, you need to pull off the input shaft (1), synchromesh ring (2) and needle bearing (3).
What is the specified play adjustment between the snap ring and guide sleeve?
The play between the snap ring and guide sleeve should be adjusted to 0...0.09 mm (0 to 0.0035 inches).
What temperature should the bearing inner race be heated to during installation?
The bearing inner race (7) should be heated to approximately 80° C (175° F) with a hot air blower before installation.
What tool is mentioned for pressing the bearing onto the output shaft?
Special Tool 23 1 440 is mentioned for pressing the bearing onto the output shaft if necessary.
What should always be replaced during this procedure?
The snap ring should always be replaced during this procedure.
What measurement examples are given for determining shim thickness?
The examples given are: A = 52.2 mm (2.056 inches), B = 52.0 mm (2.056 inches), and X = 0.2 mm (0.008 inches) shim thickness.
What components are pressed off the output shaft according to the lower left diagram?

According to the lower left diagram, the 2nd gear, needle bearing, synchromesh ring, guide sleeve, synchromesh ring, 1st gear, needle bearing with bearing sleeve and bearing inner race are pressed off the output shaft.
What should be checked regarding the synchromesh rings?
The synchromesh rings should be checked according to section 23 23 505.
How should the synchromesh ring be guided during installation?
The synchromesh ring should be guided with tabs in the sliding sleeve during installation.
Where should the bearing sleeve for reverse gear be placed?
The bearing sleeve for reverse gear should be placed in the guide sleeve.
What distance measurements are indicated by callouts A and B in the shim thickness determination procedure?
Distance A is measured from the collar of the output shaft to the bearing inner race, and distance B is measured from the collar of the guide sleeve to the bearing sleeve.
What special tool is needed to pull out the radial oil seal?
Special Tool 00 5 010 is needed to pull out the radial oil seal.
What should be done during installation of the collar nut?
Install the collar nut with bolt cement and tighten to the specified tightening torque.
What special tools are needed to drive in the radial oil seal?
Special Tools 23 1 380 and 00 5 500 are needed to drive in the radial oil seal.
What preparation is required for the sealing lips before installation?
Lubricate the sealing lips with oil before installation.
Which special tool is used for versions with Integrated Vibration Damper?
For versions with Integrated Vibration Damper, use Special Tool 23 1 320 to hold the output flange.
What alternative tool can be used if the output flange removal is difficult?
If too difficult, pull off the output flange with Special Tool 33 1 150.
What component callouts are shown in the top left image?
The top left image shows callouts 30 23 126, 23 1 200, and 23 0 020.
What should be replaced during the installation process according to the first procedure?
Replace the lockplate during installation.
What section should be referenced for transmission removal procedures?
See section 23 00 022 for transmission removal procedures.
Where is the BMW code located for transmission identification?
The BMW code is die-stamped on the front case section and also marked on the front case section label.
What lubricant should be used to coat the transmission input shaft?
Coat the transmission input shaft lightly with Molykote GL 261 in the area of splines and guide pins.
What is the important step to perform before installing the transmission on ZF S 5-16 models?
Mount vent (1) prior to installation of the transmission (red label). Pull vent (1) and sleeve (2) off of the shift shaft, then lift out cap (3) and install vent (1).
What should be checked regarding the shift rod joint installation position?
Check the installed position of the shift rod joint - the offset end of the shift rod joint must face right as seen looking forward in the car.
What lubricant should be applied to guides and bearings during installation?
Coat guides (F) and bearings (L) lightly with Molykote Longterm 2.
What components are identified in the transfer shift rod joint procedure?
The procedure shows pushing back the locking sleeve (1) and driving out the dowel pin (2).
What important note is given about oil level checking after transmission installation?
Transmissions are supplied with oil since 1.86. Consequently it is only necessary to check the oil level after installation of a transmission.
What could happen if non-conformance occurs during bearing installation?
Non-conformance could cause seizure of the bearing on the guide sleeve.
What special tool is required to insert the selector arm?
Special Tool 23 1 250 is required to insert the selector arm.
How should the selector arm be positioned when removing it?
Remove the selector arm from above using a roller.
What important safety note is given about the locking lever during bearing holder removal?
Don't unscrew bolt (6). Locking lever (7) remains on the bearing holder.
What tools are needed to drive out the grooved ball bearing?
Special Tools 23 1 120 and 00 5 500 are needed to drive out the grooved ball bearing.
Where should the end of spring (3) be positioned?
Position end of spring (3) above high spot. Press (don't knock) down selector arm in this position.
What components are numbered 4, 5, 6, and 7 in the bearing holder removal diagram?
Component 4 is the selector arm, 5 is the bearing holder, 6 is a bolt, and 7 is the locking lever.
What installation method is specified for the socket head bolt?
Mount selector arm with socket head bolt before removing the special tool. Install socket head bolt with bolt cement and specified tightening torque.
What important note is given about shim X?
Important! Shim X.
How should the radial oil seal be removed?
Lift out radial oil seal.
What transmission needs to be removed according to section 23 11 013?
Remove transmission 23 00 022. Unscrew exhaust bracket (3) with rubber mounts.
What are the steps for engaging 3rd gear during transmission disassembly?
Engage 3rd gear. Push back spring sleeve (1). Drive out cylindrical pin (2). Pull off selector rod. Pull off selector rod joint.
What special tools are required to mount the transmission according to the manual?
Mount transmission on Special Tool 23 0 070 in conjunction with Special Tool 00 1 490. Drain oil.
What should you do with the grooved washer during installation according to the guide flange removal procedure?
Position grooved washer that groove faces the circlip.
What components need to be removed as shown by callouts 5, 6, and 7?
Callout 5 indicates lift out end cap, callout 6 indicates remove spring, and callout 7 indicates remove lockpin.
What cross-reference is provided for removing the guide flange?
Remove guide flange - see 23 11 622.
What should be checked during installation of components 5, 6, and 7?
Check installed position. Remove backup light switch.
What is the procedure for the cylindrical pin according to the bottom right diagram?
Drive out cylindrical pin. Unscrew bolts.
What numbered callouts are shown in the guide flange removal diagram?
The guide flange removal diagram shows callouts 1 and 2, where 1 indicates lift out circlip and 2 indicates take off grooved washer.
What is the section number and title for this transmission service procedure?
Section 23 11 013 - REMOVING AND INSTALLING OR SEALING TRANSMISSION CASE FRONT SECTION.
What transmission is shown in the modification information?
Transmission 260/5.
Since when has the synchronization been modified?
Modified synchronization since 5.85.
How many grooves does operating sleeve (1) have?
Operating sleeve (1) has two grooves.
What is the installation orientation for operating sleeve (3)?
Operating sleeve (3) with three grooves is installed with shouldered end facing 3rd gear or grooves facing 4th gear.
What is the part number for the 1st/Reverse gear synchromesh ring?
Drawing No. 011.8.0241.00 engraved.
What is the part number for the 2nd to 5th gear synchromesh ring?
Drawing No. 011.8.0161.00 engraved.
What tooth characteristic distinguishes the 1st/Reverse gear synchromesh ring?
Narrow teeth.
What tooth characteristic distinguishes the 2nd to 5th gear synchromesh ring?
Wide teeth.
Can modified shift parts be installed in all transmission 260/5 units?
No, modified shift parts can not be installed in transmissions manufactured before 5.85 (hard operation).
What lubricant should be used on the shaft pin during installation?
Molykote Longterm 2 should be applied lightly to lubricate the shaft pin.
How should the clutch slave cylinder be positioned during installation?
The bleeder screw should face down when installing the clutch slave cylinder.
What happens if the speed sender plugs are mixed up during installation?
The engine cannot be started if the plugs are mixed up.
What are the numbered components in the shift arm removal diagram?
Component 1 is the lift spring and component 2 is the boss on the case.
What tool specification is referenced for the Torx bolts?
A Torx socket is required, with the specific specification referenced in the Specifications section.
How should the transmission be supported during removal?
Support the transmission from underneath and remove the cross member, then lower the transmission to the front axle carrier.
What must be applied to splines and guide pins before transmission installation?
Give splines and guide pins a light coat of Microlube GL 261 prior to installation of the transmission.
What is the important requirement for DME sender faces?
Faces of DME senders must be free of grease and dirt.
What should be checked after installing the speed senders?
Check the installed position and ensure plugs are not mixed up. Install speed sender without ring in bore D and reference mark sender with ring in bore B.
What precaution should be taken with Torx bolts during transmission installation?
Washers must be used with Torx bolts to avoid increasing the breaking-loose torque, and tightening torque specifications should be followed.
What should be done with the reverse gear switch wires during installation?
Pull off wires on reverse gear switch and lift wire harness out of holders.
What final check should be performed after transmission installation?
Check oil level after completing the transmission installation.
Which component is labeled as number 1 in the assembly drawing?
Component number 1 is the first gear.
What does callout number 6 identify in this transmission cross-section?
Callout number 6 identifies the input shaft.
Where is the reverse gear located in relation to the other forward gears?
The reverse gear (marked as R) is positioned between the first gear and fifth gear on the upper gear cluster.
What component is shown at the bottom of the transmission case as number 8?
Component number 8 is the layshaft, located at the bottom of the transmission case.
How many forward gear positions are labeled in this transmission diagram?
There are five forward gear positions labeled: first gear (1), second gear (2), third gear (3), fourth gear (4), and fifth gear (5).
What is the relationship between the input shaft and output shaft in this assembly?
The input shaft (6) is positioned at the top/front of the transmission, while the output shaft (7) extends from the rear of the transmission case, with the gear clusters arranged between them.
Which page number is this diagram found on in the service manual?
This diagram is found on page 23-101 of the service manual.
What special tool is needed to hold the output flange when removing the lockplate?
Special Tool 23 0 020 is needed to hold the output flange with Special Tool 23 1 200.
Which special tool is used to unscrew the collar nut during transmission case rear section removal?
Special Tool 23 1 210 is used to unscrew the collar nut.
What tool combination is required to pull off the transmission case rear section?
Special Tool 23 1 350 is used in conjunction with Special Tool 33 1 301 to pull off the transmission case rear section.
What caution is given before pulling off components during transmission disassembly?
Make sure 2nd gear is engaged before pulling off cover. Swing selector shaft to the left against stop and slide forward.
What components are labeled as items 2 and 3 in the lower right diagram?
Item 2 is the spacer and item 3 is the ball bearing inner race, both of which should be removed.
When is Special Tool 33 1 150 used during the procedure?
Special Tool 33 1 150 is used to pull off the output flange if necessary.
What important note is given about the selector shaft when taking off the rear section?
There are rollers on the selector shaft that must be noted when taking off the rear section.
What is the first step in the lockplate removal procedure?
Lift out the lockplate, then apply Special Tool 23 1 200.
What must be unscrewed before removing the rear case section?
The rear case section mounting bolts must be unscrewed before removal.
What section number covers the removing and installing or sealing transmission case rear section?
Section 23 11 522 covers removing and installing or sealing transmission case rear section.
What transmission type is shown in this section drawing?
This is a section drawing of the shift mechanism for GETRAG 265/6 Overdrive Transmission.
Which selector rod is used for 3rd and 4th gear?
The selector rod for 3rd/4th gear is indicated by callout number 2.
What does callout number 8 identify in this transmission diagram?
Callout number 8 identifies the reversing lever.
Where is the selector shaft located in relation to the selector rods?
The selector shaft (callout 4) is positioned centrally and connects to the selector rods through the selector arm mechanism.
What component allows the selector shaft to engage different gear selector rods?
The selector arm (callout 5) allows the selector shaft to engage different gear selector rods.
Which callout number corresponds to the dog component?
Callout number 7 corresponds to the dog component.
What is the function of the selector rail shown as callout 6?
The selector rail (callout 6) provides a guide and support structure for the movement of the selector mechanism components.
What tool is specified for pressing off the guide sleeve with operating sleeve and reverse gear?
Special Tool 23 2 080 is used to press off the guide sleeve with operating sleeve and reverse gear from the bottom faces of the gear wheel.
What must face the reverse gear when assembling the operating sleeve?
The stepped end of the operating sleeve must face the reverse gear.
What tool is used to press on the guide sleeve to fit tight?
Special Tool 23 1 290 is used to press on the guide sleeve to fit tight, with pressing-on force applied.
What important alignment consideration is mentioned when pressing on parts?
When pressing on parts, make sure that tabs on synchromesh ring are aligned with openings in guide sleeve.
What direction should the operating sleeve be moved during installation?
The operating sleeve should be moved in the direction of reverse gear, and the guide sleeve should be adjusted with circlip to take up all play.
What components are installed as needle bearing, 1st gear and nickle plated synchromesh ring?
The needle bearing, 1st gear and nickle plated synchromesh ring are installed, with the guide sleeve and operating sleeve placed on splines of output shaft.
What must face the first gear wheel since version 5.85?
Since 5.85, the stepped end of operating sleeve must face the first gear wheel.
What direction should the sliding sleeve be moved for 1st gear adjustment?
The sliding sleeve should be moved in the direction of 1st gear, and the guide sleeve adjusted to take up all play.
What callout number identifies the circlip in the diagrams?
Callout numbers 10 and 11 identify the circlips in the various assembly diagrams shown.
What special tool numbers are needed to press the grooved ball bearing onto the input shaft?
Special Tools 23 1 007, 23 1 000 and 23 1 006 are needed to press the grooved ball bearing onto the input shaft and into case front section.
What is the specific play measurement that should be adjusted between the bearing inner race and circlip?
The play between bearing inner race and circlip should be adjusted to 0...0.09 mm (0...0.0035 in).
What product should be used to coat the sealing surface of the oil drain plug?
The sealing surface should be coated with Loctite No. 573.
What is the important characteristic of the grooved ball bearing for the input shaft?
The inner race of the grooved ball bearing has a protrusion, and the protrusion faces the gear shaft.
How should you remove the grooved ball bearing according to the procedure?
Keep driving on the grooved ball bearing simultaneously with light hammer knocks while removing it.
What lubricants are specified for installation in the guide sleeve procedure?
Pack lubrication groove N with Molykote Longterm 2, and coat guides F and bearings L with Molykote Longterm 2.
What heating method is recommended for the bearing inner race and case front section?
Heat the bearing inner race and case front section in the area of grooved ball bearing with a hot air blower.
In the clutch release guide sleeve diagram, what do callout numbers 1, 2, and 3 indicate?
Number 1 indicates the spring to lift out, number 2 indicates the release lever to remove, and number 3 shows the thrust bearing.
What is the consequence of non-conformance during the guide sleeve installation?
Non-conformance could cause the release bearing to seize on the guide sleeve.
What should be done to the sealing surface before mounting the case front section?
The sealing surface must be thoroughly clean and dried of oil before mounting the case front section.
What procedure is described for removing the clutch release components?
Lift out spring (1) and remove release lever (2) with thrust bearing (3) as shown in the transmission removed procedure.
What is the introduction date for the operating sleeves?
The introduction date for the operating sleeves is 8.85.
How is the 1st/2nd gear operating sleeve oriented when installed?
The 1st/2nd gear operating sleeve is installed with the shouldered end of the operating sleeve facing the 2nd gear.
What do the numbered callouts 1, 3, and 5 indicate in the transmission diagrams?
The numbered callouts indicate the positions of the operating sleeves: 1 is the 1st/2nd gear operating sleeve, 3 is the 3rd/4th gear operating sleeve, and 5 is the 5th/reverse gear operating sleeve.
How many grooves does the 5th/reverse gear operating sleeve have?
The 5th/reverse gear operating sleeve has three grooves.
What important modification was made to shift parts since 11.87?
Modified synchronization since 11.87 introduced new gear wheels, synchromesh rings, guide and operating sleeves, slides, balls and springs.
How should the operating sleeve grooves be positioned for the 3rd/4th gear?
For the 3rd/4th gear operating sleeve, the grooves should be facing the 3rd gear.
What is the key difference between the operating sleeves shown in the two diagrams?
The upper diagram shows operating sleeves from introduction date 8.85, while the lower diagram shows modified operating sleeves from 11.87 with different groove configurations.
What critical installation note applies to modified shift parts?
Modified shift parts cannot be installed in transmissions manufactured earlier, as this would result in difficult operation.
How many grooves does the 1st/2nd gear operating sleeve have in the modified version?
In the modified version, the 1st/2nd gear operating sleeve has one groove.
What should you note when installing operating sleeves for correct position?
You should note the grooves on operating sleeves for correct installed position, ensuring they face the proper gear as specified for each sleeve.
Which gear does the 5th/reverse operating sleeve groove face?
The 5th/reverse operating sleeve grooves face the 5th gear.
What special tool is required for the selector shaft?
Special Tool 23 2 180 is required for the selector shaft.
What is the required axial play for the input shaft?
The axial play required is 1.1 to 1.3 mm (0.043 to 0.051").
How should the thrust washer be positioned when installing?
Hold thrust washer (4) with angle facing bore (5) in case rear section on reverse gear shaft with grease. Install gasket with grease.
What must be done with the input shaft after replacing the case or bearing?
Input shaft axial play must be adjusted after replacing case or bearing. The input shaft must rest on synchromesh ring.
What temperature should the ball bearing inner race and case front section be heated to?
Heat grooved ball bearing inner race and case front section in area of bearing to approx. 80° C (175° F).
What are the example measurements for distances A, B, and C?
What should be done if a spacer is found between the circlip and case when removing the bearing?
If a spacer is found between the circlip and case when removing the bearing, it must be installed again for measuring distance.
How should the grooved ball bearing be positioned on the input shaft?
Push grooved ball bearing on to input shaft as far as possible.
What note is given about the circlip during measurement?
The circlip must fit right in groove for measuring. Circlips are available from Parts in different thicknesses for corrections.
What component is identified as number 1 in this transmission exploded view?
Number 1 is the Ball bearing.
What are the main gear components shown in the upper shaft assembly?
The main gear components include the 4th gear (number 2), 3rd gear (number 13), 2nd gear (number 18), and 1st gear (number 19).
What component is number 5 and where is it located in the assembly?
Number 5 is the Synchromesh ring, and it appears multiple times throughout the gear assembly between various gears.
What does callout number 40 refer to in this transmission diagram?
Number 40 is the Layshaft.
What bearing components are used with the output shaft?
The output shaft (number 16) uses a Ball bearing (number 17) and other bearing components in its assembly.
What is the reverse gear component number in this transmission?
The reverse gear is identified as number 23 and number 49 in the assembly.
What component separates the different gear sets on the main shaft?
Synchromesh rings (number 5) and various washers separate the different gear sets on the main shaft assembly.
What is the function of component number 12 in this transmission?
Number 12 is the Sliding sleeve, which is part of the gear selection mechanism.
On which page can I find the layout drawing for the transmission?
Page 23-165
Where can I find information about replacing the radial oil seal for the output flange?
Section 23 12 053 on page 23-172
On which page is the vibration damper remove and install/replace procedure located?
Page 23-173a
What section should be referenced for removing the exhaust assembly during transmission removal?
See section 18 00 020 for removing the exhaust assembly.
What important precaution should be taken with the propeller shaft during transmission removal?
Don't let the propeller shaft fall into the joints. Suspend propeller shaft from car on a piece of wire.
What socket size is recommended for tightening nuts during installation?
Tighten nuts with a standard 17 mm socket together with a torque wrench.
What important guideline should be followed when tightening fasteners to avoid stress in Guibo coupling?
Only tighten nuts (never bolts) to avoid stress in Guibo coupling.
What components are indicated by callout numbers 1 and 2 in the shift rod removal diagram?
Callout 1 indicates the circlip and callout 2 indicates the washer that should be lifted out and removed.
What should be done to ensure proper bracket alignment during installation?
When tightening make sure brackets are horizontal to the shift console (shift lever noise). Always replace bolts.
What special tool is required for the threaded ring version and what is its part number?
Special Tool 26 1 040 is required for tightening the threaded ring after finishing installation.
What lubricant should be used on the bearing pin and what is the specification?
Lubricate bearing pin lightly with Molykote Longterm 2.
How should the clutch slave cylinder bleeder screw be positioned during installation?
The bleeder screw faces down during installation.
What should be done with stop nuts during bolt removal?
Replace stop nuts when unscrewing bolts.
What procedure is required for the threaded ring version during loosening?
Loosen threaded ring (1) several turns before proceeding with removal.
What temperature should the new bearing inner race be heated to before installation?
Heat the new bearing inner race to approximately 800°C (175°F) with a hot air blower and install on layshaft, driving on with Special Tool 23 1 030 if necessary.
What special tools are required to drive roller bearings for input shaft and layshaft out of the intermediate case?
Special Tools 23 1 130 and 00 5 500 are required to drive roller bearings for input shaft and layshaft out of intermediate case.
What should be done with the oil plate when dealing with roller bearing for output shaft?
Unscrew and turn oil plate (1) in case of roller bearing for output shaft.
What should be done after driving in the roller bearings?
Drive in roller bearings flush after installing them into the intermediate case.
How should the oil plate be positioned during installation?
Bolt down oil plate (1) in vertical installed position.
What should be checked on the bearing inner race of the output shaft?
Check condition of bearing inner race (2) on output shaft, replacing if necessary. If replacement is necessary, press gear set off of output shaft - see 23 21 554.
What does callout number 1 indicate in the oil plate diagram?
Callout number 1 indicates the oil plate that needs to be bolted down in vertical installed position.
What does callout number 2 refer to in the bearing inspection diagram?
Callout number 2 refers to the bearing inner race on the output shaft that should be checked for condition.
What cross-reference is provided if the output shaft gear set needs to be pressed off?
If replacement of the bearing inner race is necessary and the gear set needs to be pressed off the output shaft, see section 23 21 554.
What part faces the gear according to the collar installation instruction?
The collar of bearing race faces gear during installation.
What is the first step mentioned for the output shaft and layshaft procedure in intermediate case?
Remove input and output shaft assembly - see 23 21 503.
What procedure code corresponds to installing an exchange transmission?
Procedure code 23 00 032 corresponds to installing an exchange transmission.
What should be removed before installing the exchange transmission?
Remove transmission - see 23 00 022. BMW code marked on intermediate case section should be noted.
What do callout numbers 1, 2, and 3 indicate in the transfer spring diagram?
Number 1 indicates the transfer spring, number 2 indicates the release lever, and number 3 indicates the release component.
What components are shown in the transfer shift rod joint diagram?
The diagram shows the transfer shift rod joint with a locking sleeve (1) that needs to be pushed back, and a cylindrical pin (2) that needs to be driven out.
What type of lubricant should be used to pack the lubricating groove during installation?
Pack lubricating groove (N) with Molykote Longterm 2.
What should be applied to the guides and bearings during installation?
Give guides (F) and bearings (L) a light coat of Molykote Longterm 2.
What important note is mentioned about transmission oil after installation?
Transmissions are supplied filled with oil, so that it is only necessary to check the oil level after installation of the transmission.
What components are mentioned as part of the transfer rubber mount assembly?
Transfer rubber mount with cross member, exhaust carrier and backup light switch.
What diagram reference number is shown for the transfer spring and release lever illustration?
The diagram reference number is 316 23 024.
What diagram reference number corresponds to the lubricating groove installation diagram?
The diagram reference number is 316 23 025.
Where can additional information be found according to the note at the bottom of the page?
See Parts Microfiche for additional information.
What is the proper clearance adjustment between circlip and guide sleeve?
The play between circlip and guide sleeve should be adjusted to 0...0.09 mm (0 to 0.0035").
What is the important operating instruction for the 3rd/4th gear operating sleeve?

Operate 3rd/4th gear operating sleeve by hand in direction of 3rd gear, press off 3rd gear with guide and operating sleeve using Special Tool 23 1 490, then remove needle bearing with pressing off force.
What should always be replaced during circlip installation?
Always replace circlip during both removal and installation procedures.
What is removed in step showing components 7 and 8?
Lift out circlip (7) and remove spacer (8).
Why is synchronization marking recommended when disassembling the output shaft?
It is recommended to mark synchromesh rings and their corresponding gear wheels when disassembling the output shaft in order to avoid mixing up synchromesh rings.
What important step must be done before pressing off 1st gear?
Remove circlip (10) before pressing off 1st gear.
What tool is used for pressing off the bearing sleeve and 2nd gear?
Special Tool 23 1 490 is used to press off bearing sleeve and 2nd gear, and to remove nickle-plated synchromesh ring and needle bearing.
What section should be referenced for additional specifications?
See Specifications section for additional information.
What is the procedure number for replacing the output shaft?
The procedure is numbered 23 21 554 for replacing output shaft with output shaft removed.
What special tool is required to install the selector arm?
Special Tool 23 1 250 is required to install the selector arm.
What should you check during installation regarding the locking lever and thrust pin?
Check the installed position of locking lever (4) and thrust pin (7).
How should the spring end be positioned during installation?
Position the end of spring (3) above the high spot, and in this position push down on the selector arm (don't knock down).
What must be applied to the socket head bolt before removing the special tool?
The socket head bolt must be tightened with correct torque and secured with a locking compound before removing the special tool.
What components should be removed after unscrewing the bolt?
After unscrewing the bolt, remove the locking lever (4), shim (5), and bearing holder (6).
What should be installed with the bolt during reassembly?
Install the bolt with a large washer during reassembly.
What important note is given about the roller during removal?
The important note states "Roller" when removing the selector arm from above.
How do you determine the proper shim thickness?
Determine the thickness of shim X by measuring distance A and distance B, then calculating the difference to find the required shim thickness.
What is the section number for disassembling and assembling complete synchronization with output shaft removed?
Section 23 23 505.
What type of synchromesh rings should be used for repairs?
Only use molybdenum-coated synchromesh rings for repairs.
What materials are the synchromesh rings made of for different gears?
Synchromesh Ring for 3rd/4th Gears: brass; Synchromesh Ring for 1st/2nd Gears: brass, hard nickel plated; Synchromesh Ring for Reverse Gear: brass, molybdenum coated.
What must be checked between the synchromesh ring and clutch body?
Check distance between synchromesh ring and clutch body. Measure in area of stops.
How should the synchromesh ring be positioned for measuring?
Synchromesh ring must be pressed on slightly for measuring.
What is the critical requirement for synchromesh ring contact?
Synchromesh rings must have uniform contact on entire surface.
What components make up the synchronizer assembly that needs to be disassembled?
Thrust piece (1), spring (2) and ball (3).
Which end of the thrust pieces must face the operating sleeve?
Stepped end of thrust pieces faces the operating sleeve.
What components have a weaker version in the modified synchronization since 5.85?
Thrust pieces (1), springs (2) and balls (3) in weaker version.
What must face the long collar of the guide sleeve for the 3rd/4th gear guide sleeve?
The operating sleeve with the stepped end faces the long collar (4) of the guide sleeve.
How far should the guide sleeve be inserted into the operating sleeve initially?
Insert guide sleeve in operating sleeve half the distance. Press in balls far enough that the guide sleeve can be pressed into the operating sleeve.
What is the procedure number for replacing bearings of all transmission shafts?
The procedure number is 23 21 703 for replacing bearings of all transmission shafts.
What important caution is given regarding the input shaft collar?
The collar on clutch end must be handled with care, as indicated by the Important! notation.
How should the circlip be loosened on the layshaft?
Loosen circlip (1) with one knock from Special Tools 23 1 270 and 00 5 500.
What components should be removed after lifting out the circlip on the layshaft?
After lifting out circlip (2), remove spacer (3).
What should be done with the O-ring when working on the output shaft?
Lift out O-ring (4) with a feeler gage blade, replace it and coat the new O-ring with engine oil prior to installation of the bearing shell in the groove.
What is the first step for working on the output shaft in the rear case section?
Unscrew bolt (1) from the output shaft.
What safety caution is mentioned regarding the spring on the output shaft?
Caution! Spring force. Remove spring (2).
What should be done during installation of the output shaft bolt?
Install bolt with locking compound and apply the specified tightening torque.
What reference section should be consulted for specifications and what is the source of supply?
See Specifications section, with Source of Supply being HWB.
What is the protrusion measurement for the layshaft roller bearing when driving it out?
The protrusion A should be approximately 5 mm (0.197") when driving out the layshaft roller bearing.
How should the ball bearing be installed when replacing transmission shaft bearings?
The ball bearing should be installed so that the collar faces out.
What tools are needed to drive the layshaft roller bearing out and in?
Special Tools 23 1 220 and 00 5 500 are needed to drive the layshaft roller bearing out and in.
What must be removed before accessing the output shaft layshaft in the rear case section?
The rear case section must be removed (see 23 11 022), and the radial oil seal must be lifted out.
What components are numbered 2 and 3 in the output shaft layshaft diagram?
Component 2 is the spacer and component 3 is the bearing inner race that needs to be removed.
What important detail about the turning lock is mentioned for the input shaft bearing installation?
The turning lock must be used, and pin (2) must be in the opening of the bearing inner race during installation.
What should be done with the collar of the bearing inner race during installation?
The collar of the bearing inner race should face the gear during installation.
Which special tool is used along with the hot air blower for bearing installation?
Special Tool 23 1 440 is used along with the hot air blower for bearing installation if necessary.
How should the roller bearing be installed regarding its orientation?
The roller bearing should be installed so that the open end faces in.
What is the first step for removing the case front section when replacing input shaft bearings?
Remove the case front section as described in section 23 11 013, then drive the ball bearing out of and into the case.
What special tool is required for installing the threaded ring?
Special Tool 26 1 040 is required after finishing the installation.
What is the recommended torque specification for tightening nuts with socket together?
Use a standard 17 or 19 mm wrench socket together with a torque wrench, following the tightening torque specifications.
What should always be replaced when working with stop nuts?
Always replace stop nuts when unscrewing the joint disc on transmission.
What components are shown in callouts 1 and 2 in the shift console removal diagram?
Callout 1 indicates the retainer and callout 2 indicates the washer that should be taken off when lifting out the retainer.
Which BMW model number is specifically noted for the vibration damper mounting?
BMW 325 i is noted, where the vibration damper is mounted together with the joint disc.
What should be done with the console orientation during installation?
Make sure consoles are horizontal to the shift console while tightening to prevent shift lever noise.
What type of bolts are mentioned as being difficult to unscrew?
Self-locking bolts are mentioned as being hard to unscrew.
What cross-reference is given for removing the transfer box?
See section 27 10 010 for removing the transfer box.
What should always be replaced when working on bolts during installation?
Always replace bolts during installation procedures.
What important design consideration is mentioned when tightening nuts?
Only tighten nuts on flange end, whenever possible by design, to avoid tension in the joint disc.
What component is labeled as item 5 in this transmission gear set diagram?
Item 5 is the Input shaft with 4th gear.
Which numbered components are identified as synchromesh rings in this assembly?
Items 6, 20, 23, and 29 are identified as synchromesh rings.
What is the function of component 27 in this transmission layout?
Component 27 is the Output shaft.
Where is the reverse gear located in this transmission assembly?
The reverse gear is item 28, positioned on the lower shaft assembly.
What type of bearing is used at position 26 in this gear set?
Position 26 is a needle bearing.
Which component connects to the speedometer drive according to this diagram?
Item 37 is the speedometer drive gear.
What is the identification number for the layshaft in this transmission?
The layshaft is item 44 in this assembly diagram.
How many different gears are specifically labeled in this transmission layout?
There are four specifically labeled gears: 1st gear (item 25), 2nd gear (item 19), 3rd gear (item 15), and reverse gear (item 28), plus the input shaft with 4th gear (item 5).
What special tools are needed to pull the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft into the case rear section?
Special Tools 23 1 300 and 23 2 150 are needed to pull the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft into the case rear section.
What are the 10 components shown in the arrest assembly diagram?
The components are: 1-End cap, 2-Spring, 3-Locking ball, 4-Detent ball, 5-Lockpin, 6-Selector arm, 7-Lockpin, 8-Spring, 9-Locking lever, 10-Spring.
What should be done to the selector rods before sliding the 3rd/4th gear selector rod through the selector forks?
Move selector rods to neutral position before sliding the 3rd/4th gear selector rod through the selector forks.
How should the lockpin be installed in the selector rod?
Install lockpin (1) in selector rod with grease, push in selector rod up to bore, with opening in selector rod faces up.
What size pin should be driven into the 3rd/4th gear selector fork?
Drive a 6 x 26 mm pin into the 3rd/4th gear selector fork (counterhold).
How should the detent balls be installed?
Install two detent balls with grease, push in 3rd/4th gear selector rod against lock.
What components need to be inserted for the version with different length springs?
Insert three locking balls and three springs. For the version with different length springs, install short spring (1) with a relaxed length (A) of 15.9 mm to face 5th/reverse gear selector rod.
What gears are engaged when heating the ball bearing inner race?
Second and reverse gears are engaged when heating the ball bearing inner race.
What should be done after inserting the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft?
Align selector rods after inserting the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft in the case rear section.
What is the relaxed length specification for the short spring in versions with different length springs?
The short spring (1) has a relaxed length (A) of 15.9 mm (0.626 inches).
What Loctite number should be used when replacing the end cap?
Loctite No. 573 should be used when replacing and installing the end cap.
What is the proper procedure for positioning the output shaft and engaging second gear?

Position the output shaft upright, engage second gear, then adjust the reverse/5th gear selector rod until the opening of the 5th gear selector rod is aligned with the end of the 1st/2nd gear selector rod.
What important preparation step must be done before applying Loctite No. 573 to sealing surfaces?
Sealing surfaces must be cleaned thoroughly and dried of oil before coating with Loctite No. 573.
What does callout number 6 indicate in the transmission assembly procedure?
Callout number 6 shows pressing the lockpin into the opening of the 1st/2nd gear selector rod, with instructions to push on and bolt down the transmission case rear section.
What special tool is required for driving in the radial oil seal?
Special Tool 23 1 370 is required to drive in the radial oil seal flush.
What critical requirement is mentioned for the lockpin installation?
The lockpin must move easily and face down after installation.
What should be done with the rollers during transmission case mounting?
Hold the rollers in position with grease when mounting the transmission case rear section.
What does callout number 9 show in the bearing installation diagram?
Callout number 9 indicates the bearing inner race that should be heated to 80°C and slid onto the output shaft.
What component is shown in callout number 2 and what installation step is required?
Callout number 2 shows a spacer that needs to be installed during the assembly process.
What specific action should be taken regarding the spring of the selector arm during installation?
Make sure the spring of the selector arm engages on lever 8 during the mounting procedure.
What tool number is referenced for knocking against the ball bearing if necessary?
Special Tool 23 1 440 should be used if it's necessary to knock against the ball bearing during output shaft installation.
What is the critical alignment requirement when installing the synchromesh ring?
The tabs on the synchromesh ring must be aligned with openings in the guide sleeve while installing.
What range of circlip thicknesses is available from Parts?
Circlips are available from Parts in different thicknesses from 1.7 to 2.0 mm (0.067 to 0.079 inches).
What components should be installed together as shown in the needle bearing installation step?
Install the needle bearing, nickle-plated synchromesh ring and 2nd gear together.
What must the collar for the bearing sleeve do on the output shaft?
The collar for bearing sleeve on output shaft must protrude slightly, and if necessary, check circlip for proper fit.
What components are installed in the version with thrust washer?
Install thrust washer (1) and ball (2), then heat bearing sleeve (3) without collar to about 80°C (175°F) with a hot air blower and install on output shaft.
What is the groove orientation for the version with 2 grooves?
For the version with 2 grooves, the grooves face 3rd gear.
What should be checked during the guide sleeve adjustment procedure?
Adjust guide sleeve to remove all play, and install circlip (10).
What critical step must be performed when pressing on the guide sleeve with Special Tool 23 1 290?
Make sure while pressing on that tabs on the synchromesh ring are aligned with openings in the guide sleeve, then install shim and circlip.
Where should the guide and operating sleeves be installed in relation to the splines?
Install guide and operating sleeves on splines with the groove facing 4th gear.
What measurement is shown as distance A in the example?
Distance A is 25.3 mm (0.996").
What must the input shaft rest on during measurement?
The input shaft must rest on synchromesh ring.
What is measured as distance B from the guide sleeve sealing surface?
Distance B is measured from the guide sleeve sealing surface to circlip bearing surface, which is 10.1 mm (0.398") in the example.
What is the critical requirement for the circlip during measurement C?
The circlip must be pressed tight in groove for measuring.
What does measurement C represent?
Measurement C is the distance from bearing outer race to circlip, which is 14.0 mm (0.551") in the example.
What components are shown installed in the first diagram?
The output shaft and case front section are installed, with the input shaft resting on synchromesh ring.
Where can circlips of different thicknesses be obtained?
Circlips are available from Parts in different thicknesses for making corrections.
What calculation determines the required correction?
The calculation is 15.2 mm (0.598") minus 14.0 mm (0.551") equals 1.2 mm (0.047") correction needed.
What reference is given for installing the grooved ball bearing?
Install grooved ball bearing (see 23 11 014).
What is being adjusted in this procedure?
The axial play of input shaft is being adjusted.
What does the letter A indicate in the first diagram?
Letter A indicates the distance being measured from guide sleeve sealing surface to input shaft.
What should be removed after supporting the transmission from underneath?
Remove cross member (5).
What is the next step after lowering the transmission to the front axle carrier?
Unscrew bracket (6).
What lubricant should be used to pack the clutch release bearing groove?
Pack lubricating groove (N) with Molykote Longterm 2.
What component is indicated by callout number 5 in the diagram?
Callout number 5 indicates the cross member that needs to be removed.
How should the transmission be removed from the clutch housing?
Unscrew transmission on clutch housing and remove toward rear. Use special ring wrench to loosen and tighten nuts at top left.
What special tool is required for the nuts at the top left of the transmission?
Use special ring wrench to loosen and tighten nuts at top left.
What could happen if the clutch release bearing is not properly aligned?
Non-conformance could cause bearing to seize on guide sleeve.
What should be done before connecting the transmission during installation?
Engage gear before connecting transmission. Insert guide sleeve of transmission in bearing carefully.
What final checks should be performed after mounting the transmission?
Check oil level after mounting the transmission.
What is the procedure code for removing and installing or replacing the vibration damper?
The procedure code is 23 13 010.
What should be done first when removing the vibration damper?
First unscrew the propeller shaft at front and center mount, see 23 00 022, then lift out lockplate.
What type of thread compound should be used when installing the collar nut?
Install the collar nut with a bolt cement, Loctite No. 270.
How many staybolts mount the vibration damper to the output flange?
The vibration damper is mounted on the output flange with three staybolts.
What special tool is needed to pull off the output flange?
Special Tool 33 1 150 is needed to pull off the output flange.
What important orientation requirement must be followed when pressing in the staybolts?
Press in the staybolts with the flat side facing the vibration damper.
What should be applied to both sides of the staybolts during installation?
Apply a suitable piece of round iron bar on both sides of the staybolts.
What precaution should be taken when screwing on nuts during installation?
Screw on nuts to avoid damaging the threads and press out staybolts.
How should the output flange be mounted during installation?
Mount the output flange with its bore on a suitable piece of pipe, then mount vibration damper with the staybolts and press in the staybolts.
Which component is labeled as number 6 in the transmission cross-section?
Number 6 identifies the Input shaft.
Where is the layshaft located in this transmission diagram?
The layshaft is labeled as number 8 and is positioned in the lower portion of the transmission case.
What does the 'R' designation refer to in the component list?
The 'R' designation refers to the Reverse gear.
What is the relationship between components 6 and 7 in the transmission layout?

Component 6 (Input shaft) and component 7 (Output shaft) are positioned on opposite sides of the transmission, with the input shaft on the left side and output shaft on the right side of the assembly.
What guide sleeve must be removed before replacing the radial oil seal?
Remove guide sleeve 23 11 623.
What must be done to the transmission case before installing the new seal?
Open end faces transmission case.
What lubrication requirement is specified for the seal installation?
Lubricate sealing lip with oil.
What is the part number for the seal installation tool shown in the lower diagram?
The seal installation tool is part number 23 1 360.
What component is labeled as 320 23 049 in the lower diagram?
Component 320 23 049 appears to be part of the seal installation tool assembly.
What is the first step when the transmission is already removed?
Remove guide sleeve 23 11 623, then remove radial oil seal.
What type of seal is being replaced in this procedure?
A radial oil seal for the input shaft is being replaced.
What prerequisite condition is mentioned for this procedure?
The transmission must be removed before performing this procedure.
How many special tools are shown in the installation diagram?
Two special tools are shown: 23 1 360 and 00 5 500.
What important precaution must be observed when pulling in the shafts?
Make sure selector rods and layshaft are not clamped while pulling in parts.
What are the first steps for preparing the selector rods during assembly?
Move selector rods to neutral position. Slide 3rd/4th gear selector rod through selector forks.
What is component number 4 in the arrest assembly diagram?
Component number 4 is the Detent ball in the arrest assembly.
How many detent balls should be installed and with what lubricant?
Install two detent balls with grease. Push in 3rd/4th gear selector rod against lock.
What important note applies to versions with different length springs?
Version with Different Length Springs: Install short spring (1) with a relaxed length (A) of 15.9 mm (0.626") to face the 5th reverse gear selector rod.
How many locking balls and springs need to be installed according to the final step?
Install three locking balls and three springs.
What is the purpose of aligning the selector rods during the heating process?
Align selector rods during the heating process to ensure proper positioning when the heated bearing inner race is installed.
What does component number 7 represent in the arrest assembly?
Component number 7 is the Lockpin in the arrest assembly.
What should be removed from the guide sleeve according to reference 23 11 623?
Remove guide sleeve - see 23 11 623. Unscrew backup light switch. Remove cap (1). Pull out spring (2) and lockpin (3). Check installed position!
What components are identified by callout numbers 2 and 3 in the guide sleeve diagram?
Callout number 2 indicates the spring and callout number 3 indicates the lockpin.
What should always be replaced during installation according to the snap ring removal procedure?
Always replace snap ring.
What is the proper orientation for installing the roller bearing on the layshaft?
Install roller bearing on layshaft that small diameter end faces up.
Why should the rollers be coated with grease during installation?
Coat rollers with grease and press in, in order to avoid clamping of rollers while mounting the front case section.
What type of bolt cement is specified for bolt installation?
Install bolt with a bolt cement. The source of supply is specified as HWB.
What surface preparation is required before coating the case front section?
Surface must be cleaned thoroughly and dried of oil.
What should be checked during bolt installation?
Check length of bolts. Bolt (1) = 8 x 60 mm.
What components need to be driven out and unscrewed from the cylindrical pins?
Drive out cylindrical pins. Unscrew bolts.
What sealing compound is specified for coating the case front section?
Coat case front section with a surface sealing compound in area of the reverse gear shaft.
What special tool is used to pull the 5th gear wheel off of the layshaft?
Special Tool 23 0 080 is used to pull the 5th gear wheel off of the layshaft.
What safety caution is given regarding the use of Special Tool 23 0 080?
The caution states to prevent the pulling-off tool from falling down and causing injury, as this also pulls off the bearing inner race with pressing-off force.
What is the important note about installing 5th gear in relation to the layshaft?
When installing 5th gear, always remember to provide play between 3rd gear and layshaft to avoid damaging the 3rd gear wheel, and push up the output shaft if necessary.
Which special tools are used to pull the bearing inner race off of the output shaft?
Special Tools 23 1 100 and 00 7 500 are used to pull the bearing inner race off of the output shaft.
What procedure is described for removing needles on the selector shaft?
Drive out pin (3) in the selector shaft while counterholding, then pull out the selector shaft toward rear and remove the selector arm.
What components need to be taken off according to the first step shown?
Take off washer (1) and ball (2).
What should be done when engaging 2nd gear during the procedure?
Drive out pin (4) while counterholding when engaging 2nd gear.
What installation instruction is given for both the selector shaft and 2nd gear procedures?
For both procedures, the installation instruction is to replace the pin.
What is pulled off with the synchromesh ring and split needle bearing in step 2?
The 5th gear wheel is pulled off with the synchromesh ring and split needle bearing.
What section number covers removing and installing the input and output shaft assembly?
Section 23 21 503 covers removing and installing the input and output shaft assembly.
What is the condition specified for the front and rear transmission case sections during this procedure?
The front and rear transmission case sections are removed during this procedure.
What reference is made at the bottom of the page for additional information?
The page references 'See Specifications' for additional information.
What is the acceptable axial play range for the layshaft when checking through the bore for the oil filler plug?
The axial play should be 0.13 to 0.23 mm (0.005 to 0.009 inches).
Where should the tip of the dial gage be positioned when installing the holder with dial gage?
The tip of the dial gage must bear on the tooth of the layshaft.
What is the target adjustment range for play when installing the gear wheel set?
Adjust play to 0 to 0.09 mm (0 to 0.0035 inches).
What components are shown in the upper illustration with part number 630 23 272?
The upper illustration shows the installation of a holder with dial gage for measuring layshaft axial play, with the dial gage tip positioned on a tooth of the layshaft.
What procedure should be followed after determining the thickness of the drive pinion shim?
Install the old shim and circlip, then adjust play to the specified range of 0 to 0.09 mm.
What component is being measured in the lower illustration with part number 630 23 209?
The lower illustration shows the gear wheel set installation and measurement of the drive pinion shim thickness.
What is the first step when installing the gear wheel set?
Determine the thickness of the drive pinion shim.
What tool is required for checking layshaft axial play?
A holder with dial gage is required for checking layshaft axial play.
What specific measurement point is used when checking layshaft axial play?
The measurement is taken through the bore for the oil filler plug.
What components need to be installed after determining the drive pinion shim thickness?
Install the old shim and circlip after determining the drive pinion shim thickness.
What is the part number for the special tool used to mount transmission 23 00 022?
The special tool part number is 23 0 090, which mounts on Special Tool 00 1 490.
What should be done with the oil when mounting the transmission on the special tool assembly?
The oil should be drained when mounting the transmission on the special tool assembly.
What part number guide sleeve needs to be removed and what step follows?
Remove guide sleeve 23 11 624, then lift out circlip (1).
What important installation note is given regarding the magnet in the case rear section?
The magnet (2) in case rear section must be cleaned during installation.
What components need to be unscrewed when removing the backup light switch?
Unscrew the backup light switch, drive back cylindrical pins, and unscrew bolts.
What special tool is required to pull off the case front section?
Special Tool 23 1 460 and 23 1 301 are required to pull off the case front section.
What should be done with the gasket when installing the case front section?
Replace the gasket during installation of the case front section.
In what direction should the grooved ball bearing be driven out?
The grooved ball bearing should be driven out in the direction of the clutch housing.
What is the main procedure covered in section 23 11 014?
Section 23 11 014 covers removing and installing sealing transmission case front section.
What component is identified by callout number 1 in the transmission case diagram?
Callout number 1 identifies the circlip that needs to be lifted out after removing the guide sleeve.
What material coating is applied to all synchromesh rings?
All synchromesh rings are identical and coated with molybdenum on the inside.
What should you check between the synchromesh ring and clutch when measuring in the area of stops?
Check distance between synchromesh ring and clutch. Measure in area of stops.
What components need to be disassembled from the synchronization unit?
Disassemble the pressure piece (1), spring (2), and ball (3) from the synchronization unit.
What alignment requirement must be met during installation of the operating sleeve?
Bore (4) in operating sleeve must be aligned with ball (3) during installation.
What is the proper orientation for the curved surface of pressure pieces during installation?
The curved surface of pressure pieces faces the operating sleeve during installation.
What is the final step for pressing in the balls during assembly?
Press in balls far enough until the guide sleeve can be pressed into the operating sleeve.
What should synchromesh rings bear uniformly all around?
Synchromesh rings should bear uniformly all around.
What components must be installed together according to the installation instructions?
Install all springs, pressure pieces and balls together during assembly.
What section number is this page part of in the manual?
This is section 23 23 505 covering disassembling and assembling complete synchronization with output shaft removed.
What type of compound should be used when installing the bolt in step 3?
Install bolt with a locking compound.
What is the part number referenced for the holder in the second step?
The holder is referenced as part (2).
What should be done with holder (2) after inserting it?
Insert holder (2), press out and secure in this position.
Which Special Tool is required to apply during output flange installation?
Apply Special Tool 23 1 200.
Which Special Tool is used to tighten the collar nut?
Tighten collar nut with Special Tool 23 1 210.
What is the final step shown in the last diagram?
Install and lock lockplate.
What diagram reference number is shown for the shaft mounting procedure?
The diagram reference number is 30 23 049.
What diagram reference number corresponds to the output flange installation?
The diagram reference number is 23 0 020.
What diagram reference number is shown for the lockplate installation?
The diagram reference number is 30 23 069.
What should you do to support the transmission before unscrewing the cross member?
Support transmission and unscrew cross member on body, then lower transmission.
What torque specification is referenced for the transmission installation?
Tightening torque is specified, with a reference to see Specifications section for the actual value.
What type of tool is required to unscrew the Torx bolts on the transmission?
Unscrew Torx bolts with a Torx socket.
What important precaution should be taken when installing washers on Torx bolts?
Use washers on version with Torx bolts to avoid an increase in breaking-loose torque.
What direction should the transmission be moved during removal?
Remove transmission toward rear.
What fluid level should be checked after transmission installation?
Check oil level.
What diagram number shows the transmission cross member removal procedure?
The transmission cross member removal is shown in diagram 30 23 115.
What diagram number illustrates the transmission-to-engine separation?
The transmission-to-engine separation is shown in diagram 30 23 116.
What is emphasized as important regarding the Torx bolt procedure?
The procedure is marked as Important, specifically regarding the use of washers on versions with Torx bolts.

What is the maximum amount of shims that can be used to correct deflection angles?
Up to max. 3 mm or 0.118" shims can be used on the transmission suspension or center mount to correct deflection angles.
Where should the gage be applied when measuring the propeller shaft front section angle?

Apply the gage on the propeller shaft front section and measure the angle. Measure deflection angle of joint disc and, if necessary, correct it with shims on the transmission suspension or center mount.
What are the example angles given for the engine angle and propeller shaft angle?

How should the deflection angle of the universal joint end be corrected if necessary?
Determine deflection angle of the universal joint end, and if necessary, correct it with shims (up to max. 3 mm or 0.118") on the center mount.
What important note is given about correcting deflection angles with shims?

When correcting a deflection angle by installing shims, remember that the deflection angles of the adjacent joints will also change. In general joints should have as small as possible deflection angles.
Where is the gage applied when measuring the final drive angle?
Apply gage on final drive with helping rail (steel ruler) and measure angle.
What procedure is followed for the propeller shaft rear section measurement?

Apply gage on propeller shaft rear section and measure angle. Determine deflection angle of center mount and, if necessary, correct it with shims (up to max. 3 mm / 0.118") on transmission suspension or center mount.

What components are being measured for deflection angles according to the procedures shown?
The procedures measure deflection angles of the joint disc, universal joint end, and center mount, using the propeller shaft front and rear sections as reference points.
What is the general goal regarding deflection angles in joints?
In general, joints should have as small as possible deflection angles to minimize driveline vibration and wear.
What are the main requirements for eliminating propeller shaft vibration and noise?

The requirements include elimination of disturbances from faulty engine and transmission mounts, tension in exhaust assembly, etc. The propeller shaft must be in perfect optical and mechanical condition, and if balance plates are missing or propeller shaft is suspected to have imbalance, refer to instructions supplied with balancing equipment.
What is the important safety caution when testing a jacked up car?

A jacked up car may only be tested or operated when the suspension of driven wheels is supported (deflection angle of output shafts). Never exceed the maximum speed specified for a car jacked up or on a dynamometer, and conform with safety regulations.

Move transmission to the side until the special tool gage shows equal spacing on left and right sides.
What is the graduation value when reading the special tool gage?
One graduation equals 5 degrees. Always apply the gage with the scale in the same direction (e.g. scale right).
What does the manual specify about car position when measuring propeller shaft angles?
The position of the car is not important, since only relative angles are compared.

If possible by design, only turn the nuts or bolts on the flange end to avoid torsion in joint coupling.

Bend down and pull propeller shaft out of centering pin on transmission. If applicable, slide propeller shaft together completely on the slide.
Why can propeller shafts only be replaced as complete assemblies?
Propeller shafts are balanced in assembled state and therefore may only be replaced as complete assemblies.

Propeller shaft without influence. The correction is to check engine tuning and remove stress in exhaust line.

Check if the propeller shaft is aligned precisely. If not aligned, align propeller shaft using procedure S. I. 26 01 77 (235).

What should I do if there's runout on centering pin, transmission or final drive flanges?

What should be removed before unscrewing the heat shield during joint disc replacement?
Remove primary and final mufflers 18 12 000 before unscrewing the heat shield.
What special procedures apply to models from 1983 onwards?
Since 1983 models require unscrewing the connector as an additional step.
What special tools are required for cars with 4 HP 22 automatic transmission?
