Special Tool 36 1 000 is required for measuring tire runout.
How should Special Tool 36 1 000 be positioned when measuring radial runout?
Special tool must be perpendicular to the tire's road contact surface when measuring radial runout.
What is the procedure for measuring maximum tire radial runout?
Apply Special Tool 36 1 000 on road contact surface of tire, turn wheel by hand and measure max. tire radial runout.
How should the special tool be positioned when measuring lateral runout?
Special tool must be perpendicular to the tire's side surface when measuring lateral runout.
What important warning is given about measuring on tire specifications?
Don't measure on tire specifications - this is noted as an important caution.
What additional reference document should be consulted for this procedure?
Workshop Equipment Planning Documents should be referred to for additional information.
Where can you find the specifications for tire runout measurements?
See Specifications section for tire runout measurement values and tolerances.
What is the procedure number for replacing the front panel with front wall assembly?
The procedure number is 41 33 001.
What part numbers are referenced for removing the engine hood complete with hinges?
The part numbers are 41 61 000 and 41 61 050.
What components need to be removed along with the front bumper?
You need to remove the grill, headlights, front fog lights, horns, engine hood lock, data plate and radiator.
What part number is specified for removing the front bumper?
The front bumper part number is 51 11 000.
What method is used to remove the front wall from the wheel house?
The front wall should be cut off from the wheel house.
How should the welding seams be removed when taking off the front wall?
The welding seams should be ground off to take off the front wall.
What part number is associated with removing both front side panels?
The part number for removing both front side panels is 41 35 000.
What finishing work is required after removing scrap metal?
After removing scrap metal, you need to straighten and grind mating surfaces, then coat with zinc dust paint.
What specific area needs welding seam grinding according to the bottom right image?
The welding seams on the towline eye need to be ground off.
What is the first step mentioned in the procedure?
The first step is to disconnect the battery ground lead.
What are the three types of welds shown in the welding procedure images?
The three types of welds shown are: insert gas plug weld front wall on engine carrier (shown in two different views), and insert gas weld front wall on end plate.
What part numbers are referenced for the welding procedures?
The part numbers referenced are 30 41 042, 30 41 043, and 30 41 044.
Where should the gas plug weld be inserted on the engine carrier?
The gas plug weld should be inserted on the front wall of the engine carrier.
What material should be applied to mating surfaces and joints during body work?
Body sealing compound should be applied to all mating surfaces and joints.
What type of weld is used on the end plate?
An insert gas weld is used on the front wall of the end plate.
What should be coated with body sealing compound?
All mating surfaces and joints should be coated with body sealing compound.
What part number corresponds to the end plate welding procedure?
Part number 30 41 044 corresponds to the end plate welding procedure.
What type of compound is specified for sealing body joints?
A body sealing compound is specified for coating all mating surfaces and joints.
Which welding procedure shows the final sealing step?
The final image (30 41 045) shows the sealing step where all mating surfaces and joints are coated with body sealing compound.
What is the section number for replacing the right rear side panel?
The section number is 41 35 291.
What type of replacement is being performed on the right rear side panel?
This is a partial replacement up to the window line for a two door model.
What are some of the components that need to be removed or disconnected before replacing the right rear side panel?

Components include the rear bumper, right tail light assembly, trunk mat, trunk wall trim, right wheel house trim, tail panel trim, trunk lid seal, rear window complete with frame, side window, rear seat cushion and backrest, side trim panel, hatrack, entrance cover strip, and carpet as required.
What additional items need to be removed that are related to the door and pillar areas?
Remove the roof liner as required, door pillar trim, seat belt, front door weatherstrip, door striker, C pillar air extraction plate, and rubbing strip on rear side panel.
What fuel system components need to be addressed during this repair?
The right wheel house cover, fuel filler neck, expansion tank, complete fuel tank, strut on floor assembly, and wire harness in trunk need to be removed or disconnected as required.
What is the first step shown in the repair procedure according to the diagrams?
The first step is to uncover and drill off welding spots, as indicated in the top diagram.
What do callout numbers 30 41 209 and 30 41 210 indicate?
These callouts show the steps for determining the cutting line for partial replacement of the panel.
What does callout number 30 41 123 demonstrate?
This callout shows cutting off the side panel on the tail panel and trunk side section.
What welding-related procedure is repeated multiple times in this repair?
Uncovering and drilling off welding spots is performed multiple times throughout the procedure, as shown in callouts 30 41 211 and 30 41 212.
What is the purpose of determining cutting lines during this repair?
The cutting lines are determined to establish the proper boundaries for the partial replacement of the side panel, ensuring accurate fitting of the new panel section.
What does the final diagram (30 41 070) show?
The final diagram shows the completed cut-off of the side panel on the tail panel and trunk side section.
What is the procedure number for replacing the cross member on the trunk floor plate?
The procedure number is 41 12 545.
Where should you refer for additional information before cutting the cross member?
Refer to information on page 41-001 before cutting off the cross member along the line.
What coating should be applied to the mating surfaces of the new cross member?
Grind mating surfaces on the new cross member and coat with zinc dust paint.
How should the cross member be aligned during installation?
Align cross member in height, toward front and rear, according to seams in side members.
What welding method is specified for attaching the cross member?
Spot weld cross member on left and right sides.
What tool is used to install the cross member according to the procedure?
Install cross member with straightening bench attachment and clamp.
Which image demonstrates grinding the mating surfaces on the new cross member?
Image 30 41 273 shows grinding mating surfaces on the new cross member and coating with zinc dust paint.
What does image 30 41 276 illustrate?
Image 30 41 276 shows aligning the cross member in height, toward front and rear, according to seams in side members.
What does image 30 41 275 show regarding the installation process?
Image 30 41 275 shows installing the cross member with straightening bench attachment and clamp.
What is the BMW part number for replacing the trunk floor plate on a convertible?
The part number is 41 12 570 for replacing the trunk floor plate (partial replacement in front of cross member) with tail panel removed on convertible models.
What page should you refer to for additional information before starting this trunk floor plate repair?
You should refer to information on page 41-001 before beginning the repair work.
What precaution must be taken regarding car parts in the repair area?
You must remove or cover up all car parts which are located in the repair area or subjected to heat, sparks and dust.
Where should the trunk floor plate be cut off from the wheel house?
Cut off the trunk floor plate from the wheel house on both the left and right sides.
What needs to be made accessible before marking cutting lines?
Make left and right connections accessible before proceeding with the cutting line marking process.
Where should the cutting lines be marked for the transition area?
Mark cutting lines at height of transition on left and right sides.
What should be done to the spot welds on the left and right sides?
Drill out spot welds on left and right sides to remove the connections.
How far toward the rear should spot welds be drilled out on the side members?
Drill out spot welds on side members forward up to cutting line and approx. 80 mm (3.150") toward rear.
What must be done to make spot welding accessible during reassembly?
Make left and right spot welding accessible and drill out spot welds to prepare for new welding connections.
What should be done to prepare connections for welding?
Make connections accessible and drill out spot welds to prepare the surfaces for new welding.
What image reference number shows the cutting line marking procedure?
Image reference number 30 41 607 shows the procedure for marking cutting lines at the height of transition.
What is the overlapping distance A that should be marked toward the front when preparing a new trunk floor plate?
The overlapping distance A should be 20 mm (0.787") toward the front.
What should be done to the connections of the left and right side members before lifting off the trunk floor plate?
Uncover the connections of the left and right side members and drill out spot welds before lifting off the trunk floor plate complete with side members.
What tool should be used when shouldering the overlap upwards with sheet metal?
Use shouldering pliers when shouldering the overlap upwards with sheet metal.
Where should the car be positioned when fitting in the trunk floor plate?
Set up the car on a straightening bench when fitting in the trunk floor plate.
What should be marked on the trunk floor plate according to the bottom right image?
Mark the location of cross member on the trunk floor plate.
What diagram number corresponds to the image showing the removal of scrap metal?
Diagram number 30 41 610 corresponds to the image showing removal of scrap metal.
What preparation step is mentioned for the new trunk floor plate?
Prepare new trunk floor plate for partial replacement by marking the line on transition and marking overlapping distance A.
What diagram number shows the car set up on the straightening bench?
Diagram number 30 41 617 shows the car set up on the straightening bench with the trunk floor plate being fitted.
What should be done with spot welds during the disassembly process?
Drill out spot welds after uncovering the connections of the left and right side members.
What diagram number corresponds to the image showing the cutting of sheet metal with shouldering pliers?
Diagram number 30 41 616 corresponds to the image showing cutting off sheet metal and shouldering the overlap upwards with shouldering pliers.
What should you ensure when making the cowl panel grab underneath connection for A pillar?
Make sure cowl panel grabs underneath connection for A pillar.
What components should be installed along with the roof panel?
Install roof panel and install windshield with several pieces of rubber frame.
What should be checked after installing the windshield and roof panel?
Check for uniform clearance and same curvature between glass pane and body opening.
What connection method is used on the A pillar according to image 30 41 206?
Braze connection on A pillar.
What should be done if necessary regarding the connection on A pillar?
If necessary, tin cut connection on A pillar and match contour on front side panel.
What image number shows the spot welding of the cowl panel?
Image 30 41 205 shows spot weld cowl panel.
What image number demonstrates the roof panel installation?
Image 30 41 204 shows the install roof panel procedure.
What contour matching is required when working on the A pillar connection?
Match contour on front side panel when making the A pillar connection.
What type of frame material is used with the windshield installation?
Several pieces of rubber frame are used with the windshield installation.
What image number shows the procedure for tinning and cutting the A pillar connection?
Image 30 41 208 shows the procedure for tin cut connection on A pillar and matching contour on front side panel.
Where should holes be drilled for plug spot welding on the engine carrier?
Drill holes for plug spot welding in area of engine carrier.
What equipment is needed to set up the car for wheel house installation?
Set up car on straightening bench. Install, align and tack weld new wheel house.
Which component should be spot welded on the heater separating wall?
Spot weld wheel house on heater separating wall.
How should the wheel house be attached to the end plate?
Spot weld wheel house on end plate.
What is shown in the image with part number 30 41 489?
The image shows setting up the car on a straightening bench for wheel house installation and alignment.
How should the wheel house be attached through the provided holes?
Plug spot weld wheel house through provided holes.
What component is being welded to the engine carrier in the procedure?
Spot weld wheel house on engine carrier.
What should be done with the connections of the left and right side members before drilling out spot welds?
Uncover connections of left and right side members, drill out spot welds, then lift off trunk floor plate complete with side members.
What type of paint should be used on mating surfaces after straightening and grinding?
Coat mating surfaces required for spot welding with zinc dust paint.
What distance measurement A is specified for overlapping when cutting the trunk floor plate?
Mark distance A = 20 mm (0.787'') forward from the marked line for overlapping.
What should be checked in the area of the spare wheel well after grinding?
Check opening in area of the spare wheel well after grinding off cut flush with flange of the cross member.
Where should spot welding holes be drilled for side members?
Drill plug spot welding holes in mating surfaces for side members. Also drill holes in flanges of side members through the trunk floor plate.
What preparation steps are required before spot welding?
Remove scrap metal, straighten and grind mating surface, and coat mating surfaces required for spot welding with zinc dust paint.
What should be done with the car before inserting the trunk floor plate?
Set up car on straightening bench, then insert trunk floor plate.
What should be marked on the new part when installing cross member connections?
Mark location of cross member connections on new part from underneath, then lift off trunk floor plate.
What happens when spot welds are applicable according to the note?
Drill out spot welds when applicable.
What area of the new trunk floor plate should be cut?
Cut off new trunk floor plate in area of holes.
What should be done after marking the distance for overlapping?
Cut off excessive metal after marking distance A = 20 mm (0.787'') forward from the marked line for overlapping.
What component positioning equipment is specified for this repair?
A straightening bench is required to properly set up the car during trunk floor plate installation.
What reference page should be consulted before beginning this engine carrier replacement procedure?
Refer to information on page 41-001.
What should be done with both side panels during this procedure?
Remove both side panels.
What reference section should be consulted for removing the front panel with front wall?
See section 41 33 001.
What adjustment should be checked during installation?
Check and adjust front wheel alignment.
What reference section covers removing the wheel house?
See section 41 14 021.
What should be done to the spot welding seams on the inside of the car?
Uncover spot welding seams on inside of car and drill off welding spots.
What should be done to the connection points on the end of the engine carrier?
Uncover points of connection on end of engine carrier, drill off welding spots, grind off welding seam, and remove engine carrier.
What preparation is required for the connection points before installation?
Straighten and grind points of connection.
What image numbers correspond to the various steps shown in the diagrams?
The diagrams show images numbered 30 41 273, 30 41 508, 30 41 509, 30 41 510, 30 41 511, and 30 41 512.
What should be done to the shouldered metal edge before installing the tail panel?
Cut off shouldered metal edge on one side far enough that tail panel can be pushed behind the side panel.
What type of welder should be used to weld the bottom of the tail panel to the side panels?
An inert gas welder should be used to weld the bottom of tail panel on left and right side panels.
How should the tail panel be secured after fitting?
Fit in and tack weld tail panel.
What type of welder is specified for welding the web of the tail panel to the side panels?
An autogen welder should be used to weld web of tail panel and left and right side panels in area of trunk lid.
How is the tail panel mounted to the bumper bracket?
Mount tail panel on bumper bracket with a bolt.
Where should the tail panel be spot welded in relation to the trunk floor?
Spot weld tail panel on trunk floor plate and bumper bracket.
What welding operation is shown in image 30 41 057?
The image shows welding the bottom of tail panel on left and right side panels with an inert gas welder.
What is demonstrated in image 30 41 058?
The image shows welding the web of tail panel and left and right side panels in area of trunk lid with an autogen welder.
What fastening method is shown in image 30 41 055?
The image shows mounting the tail panel on bumper bracket with a bolt.
How much deeper should the engine hood be adjusted compared to the side panels?
Adjust height of engine hood so that hood is approximately 1 mm (0.039") deeper than the side panels.
What parts are fitted and bolted in an unfinished body shell according to the note?
Engine hood, trunk lid and doors are fitted and bolted in an unfinished body shell.

What does SMC stand for in the context of glass fiber reinforced plastic repair?
SMC stands for Sheet Moulding Compound, which is a processing method with polyester resin saturated sheets (prepregs), which are then hardened with application of pressure and heat.
What does BMC stand for and how is it different from SMC?

BMC stands for Bulk Moulding Compound, which is an injection moulding method with application of heat and high pressure producing a sauerkraut-similar compound. Unlike SMC which uses prepreg sheets, BMC is not sheetlike.
How can you identify if a body part is made of glass fiber reinforced plastic?

Strong solid parts, insensitive to solvents. Flame test shows crispy charcoaled, yellowish red, strongly sooting flame. Only damage which has no influence on the stiffness and strength of mounting points may be repaired.
What are the advantages of the company approved ultraviolet hardening repair system?

Single component system with no mixing errors, no waste since excess material won't harden without UV light, very long application time in closed rooms, glass sheets pre-impregnated with no inclusions, easy moulding without dirtying hands, uniform handling, and reusable tools that can be stored until needed.
What tool requirements are specified for working with glass fiber reinforced plastics?

Hand tools and equipment used for sheet metal work can be applied as material removing tools. An ultraviolet lamp is required for hardening the resin. Cutting and grinding tools must be sharp and must not smear to avoid unsuitable heat that creates polished spots.
At what temperature should plastic parts be repaired?
Only repair plastic parts at room temperature.

What is the maximum temperature for heating PVC material during removal?
PVC material should be heated to a maximum of 180°C (355°F) with a hot air blower and scraped off with a spatula.
What safety hazard occurs when burning or overheating PVC material above the recommended temperature?
Burning off PVC material or heating it above 180°C (355°F) with a gas flame torch would produce strong corrosion-promoting hydrochloric acid and health impairing vapors would also be set free.
What tool is recommended for removing PVC material in the repair zone?

Why is good extraction necessary when welding galvanized sheet metal?
The welding smoke contains poisonous zinc oxide, so especially good extraction is necessary in the welding bay.
What welding method is preferred if welded connections should be made?
If at all possible welded connections should be made with resistance spot welding.
How much should welding current be boosted when working with galvanized sheet metal?
Welding current is boosted by at least 10% as compared with blank sheet metal.
Should the zinc coat be ground off for resistance spot welding?
Do not grind off zinc coat for resistance spot welding and inert gas welding. The zinc coat, however, must be ground off for brazing jobs.
Why is inert gas welding preferred over autogen welding for galvanized metal?
Inert gas welding should be preferred to autogen welding in areas not accessible for resistance spot welding, because of the lower heat dispersion.
What should be done with burnt residual zinc after welding?
Remove burnt residual zinc completely.
What happens to new undercoating applied over burnt PVC material?
New undercoating would not have sufficient adhesion on burnt PVC material and consequently undersurface rusting would be possible.
What is normal for machining or forming of galvanized sheet metal?
Machining or forming of galvanized sheet metal in warm state is normal.

How long is the minimum drying time for primer before windshield installation?
The air drying time for primer is at least 10 minutes.
What is the maximum time allowed to complete assembly after applying cement?
Assembly must be completed within 10 minutes, since otherwise the cement bead will get a skin and perfect adhesion would no longer be guaranteed.
What are the minimum hardening conditions for the cement?
The minimum hardening time is 4 hours at 22°C (72°F) and 38% relative humidity.
What components are labeled 1 through 5 in the windshield cross-section diagram?
1 is Windshield, 2 is Rubber seal, 3 is Body, 4 is Cement bead, and 5 is Rubber seal, inside.
What tool is required for removing the window?

What safety equipment should be worn when cutting out the window?

How does the cement harden and what helps the process?
The cement hardens through reaction with air moisture at room temperature, e.g. sprinkling with water.
What precaution should be taken regarding car loading during cement hardening?
The car must not be loaded onesidedly during the minimum hardening time, e.g. one wheel on a curbstone, lifting platform, etc.
What should be done with the car windows during cement hardening to avoid pressure buildup?
One side window should be left open to avoid building up pressure inside of the car by closing the doors.
What special coating is applied to the inside edges of the windshield?
The inside of the window is coated with ultraviolet-proof glass ceramic in the area of edges for protection of the cement bead.
Is it safe to drive the car without the windshield or rear window installed?
Yes, it is possible to have the car towed or driven without the windshield or rear window.

What repair material is used to repair damaged plastic bumpers?
3M Repair Material 5900 is used to repair damaged thermo-plastic bumpers.
What are the required abrasive materials for plastic bumper repair?
Aluminous abrasive fiber discs in grain size P 36 and P 80, and sandpaper in grain size P 180.
What safety precautions must be followed when grinding during bumper repair?

Extracting or grinding abrasion, wearing mask and gloves while grinding, working only in well ventilated rooms, washing hands frequently, storing food separately, not eating, drinking or smoking while working, and not inhaling vapors.
Which types of bumper damage can be repaired in the interest of safety?
Only damage that does not have influence on the strength and rigidity of the bumper may be repaired.
What is the maximum length allowed for continuous cracks that can still be repaired?
Continuous cracks with a length of more than 100 mm (4") must be replaced and cannot be repaired.
What is the maximum size hole that requires bumper replacement?
Holes from a size of 100 mm² (1.5 in.²) or larger require the bumper to be replaced.
What first aid measures should be taken if dust gets in the eyes?
Take off dirty clothes immediately. If dust has gotten in eyes, rinse out with water thoroughly and go to a physician.
What fire extinguishing agents are recommended for this repair material?
Fire extinguishing agents include powders, foam, CO₂, halon, and water mist.
What 3M materials are required for the repair besides the repair material?
3M Cement Remover 8984, 3M Aluminum Adhesive Tape Scotch 424, 3M Glass Grid Fabric 9030, and 3M Plastic Repair Material 5900.
What should be done with single components of the repair material after mixing?
Single components of the repair material must be scrapped as special refuse. After mixing the single components and hardening, it can be brought to the normal refuse station.
What types of damage on body mounting points cannot be repaired?
Damage on body mounting points and damage in immediate vicinity of body mounting points cannot be repaired and the parts must be replaced.
Where can information on painting plastic parts be found?
Refer to the BMW Painting Manual for information on painting plastic parts.

Check wire harness for breaks, repairing if necessary. Also check central ground connection behind instrument panel at bottom left.

Check wire harness for breaks, repairing if necessary.

Check push button, replacing if necessary.

Where is the central ground connection located that should be checked during this diagnostic procedure?
The central ground connection is located behind the instrument panel at bottom left.
What special tool is required for window installation and what is its part number?

Apply Special Tools 51 3 010 (1) on the window and fit window in body opening carefully, and then press on.

Check for uniform spacing between body and rubber frame all around.

What method can be used to detect leaks in the window sealing?
Leaks can be detected by spraying water underneath the sealing lip or with an ultra-sonic tester.

What is the source of supply for the repair kit mentioned in the leak detection note?
The source of supply is HWB.
What must be done to the nozzle in the repair kit before use?
The nozzle must be cut off to size to have the opening needed.
What is the first step for cars with trunk plate when removing the trunk lid lock?
Push out pins of clips downward and remove the plate.

Fold back the trunk mat and lift the rear wall trim panel at the bottom slightly and pull out.
What precaution should be taken when removing the lock from the side?
Take out the lock from the side and prevent the lock cylinder from falling out.

Remove the lock cylinder by lifting out the circlip and pulling out the lock cylinder toward the rear.
How is the locking bar removed according to the procedure?
The locking bar is removed by unscrewing the screws.

The locking bar can be adjusted in height (a) and plane (b) during installation.

What should I check first if the unlocking arrest has no function when operating?
Check if the microswitch of the driver's door is operated. If not, repair it and also refer to section 51 21 140.

For unlocking-locking function, voltage measured on control unit pin 10 (red/brown) should be greater than 9 V.

For unlocking arrest operation, voltage measured on control unit pin 10 (red/brown) should be less than 0 V.
What should I do if the voltage readings on pin 10 are incorrect?
Replace the control unit, if applicable.
How do I test the microswitch after pulling off the plug?
Pull off the plug on microswitch and measure switch end. Switch opened between terminals 1 and 2 should show infinity ohms. Switch pressed between terminals 1 and 2 should show 0 ohms.
What should I do if the microswitch test results are incorrect?
Replace the microswitch.
Which wires should I check for power flow between the microswitch and control unit?
Check power flow in wires between socket 2 on microswitch plug wire end and socket 10 on control unit (red/brown wire).
What should I check if there's no power flow in the microswitch to control unit wires?
Repair wires, if necessary. Also refer to driver's door/body plug socket 17 for corrosion or no connection.
What should I test on the white wire from the microswitch plug?
Check power flow in plug on microswitch wire end socket 1 (white). Test for continuity - it should show 0 ohms.
What's the remedy if there's a break in the ground supply wires?
Break in ground supply wires - repair. Also refer to driver's door/body plug socket no. 10 for corrosion or no connection.
What is the procedure number for replacing the left or right rear door trim panel?

An additional screw holds the armrest on the trim panel from behind.

The white wire should measure greater than 9 V while unlocking briefly.

The black wire should measure approximately 1 V while arresting briefly.

If the linkage is not connected, drive adjusted correctly, and mounted with plug connected correctly, you should connect the linkage, adjust/mount the drive, and connect the plug according to section 51 26 010.

You should check the blue/white and black wires for breaks when pulling off the plug on the control unit.

If wires show breaks when checking at the control unit, you should repair the wires.
Where should you pull off the plug to measure voltages?

What section should you reference for connecting linkage and adjusting/mounting the drive?
You should reference section 51 26 010 for connecting linkage and adjusting/mounting the drive.
What resistance value should you check for when testing the control unit wires?

What is the final action if all voltage measurements are correct at the drive?
If all voltage measurements are correct at the drive, the final action is to replace the drive.

For convertibles, you must lift out the rear seat cushion, and during installation, the seat cushion must engage in the openings.

First unscrew the bolts, then pull out the seat backrest from above. During installation, engage the backrest in the holders at the top.

Page 51-450 covers trim panel for dashboard - remove and install procedures.

The window should be operated to the half-open position before loosening the screws.

The limitation of window movement is adjusted with the stop.

Insert twisting lock in opening.

What are the recommended fire extinguishing agents for hardtop repair work?
Water mist (no water stream), powders, foam, CO₂ and halon.
What is the maximum length of cracks that can extend through the honeycomb structure before requiring hardtop replacement?
Cracks extending through the honeycomb structure with a length of more than 100 mm (4") cannot be repaired and require hardtop replacement.
What protective equipment is required when working on hardtop repairs?
Work clothes to cover bare skin, goggles, mask, and gloves are required protective equipment.
What should be done with scrapping materials after hardtop work?
Never let it get into drink water systems. It can be brought to the normal refuse station after hardening.
What two operational modes can the sun roof be operated in?
The sun roof can be operated as A) sliding roof and B) lifting roof.
What is the ideal height setting for the front of the sun roof lid?
The front should be 1 mm (0.040 inch) deeper than the roof panel.
What is the proper axial setting distance between the lid and roof?
The axial setting should be equal distance at front and rear between lid and roof, approximately 0.2 mm (0.008 inch), checked with plastic gauge.
What do the velvet strip markings V and H indicate?
V indicates the front with sealing lip, and H indicates the rear without sealing lip.
How far should you open the sun roof lid during the adjustment procedure?
Open the sun roof lid about 5 cm (2 inches).
What special tools are needed to loosen the adjustment screws?
Special Tools 00 2 102/103 are needed to loosen screws 1 through 3 on left and right sides.
What is the tightening torque for the self-locking screws?
The tightening torque is 3.5 Nm (2.5 ft. lbs.).
When is switching to lift mode possible for the sun roof?
Switching to lift is only possible with the lid closed.
What key size is used to lock the sun roof in position 0?
A 4 mm key is used to lock the sun roof in position 0 on left and right sides.
What is the complete procedure for installing the roof liner frame after adjustment?

Close the sun roof lid, pull the roof liner frame forward uniformly, open the sun roof lid slightly while holding the roof liner frame by hand, then press in holding clamps for the front roof liner frame.
What is the torque specification for tightening the adjustment nut on the sunroof motor/gear unit?
The adjustment nut should be tightened to 450 ± 35 Nm (39 ± 3 in. lbs.).
What should be lubricated during installation of the sunroof motor/gear unit?
Lubricate the teeth of the pinion, control gear and switching gear with grease.
How do you manually close the sunroof if the motor fails?
Unscrew nut (1) and turn drive shaft (2) with a socket wrench to close the roof.
What must be aligned during installation of the sunroof motor/gear unit?
The mark of switching gear (1) must be aligned with the mark of control gear (2).
What components need to be removed to access the sunroof motor/gear unit?
Remove the control switch, sun visors with holders, and pull off the edge guard panel partially.
What is the procedure reference number for replacing the microswitch for the sunroof motor?
The procedure is referenced as 54 13 012.
How should the trim be handled during removal?
Pull off the trim carefully and unscrew the left and right bolts. During installation, paste the trim.
What should be done after adjusting the sunroof motor/gear unit?
Check the function after tightening the nut to ensure proper operation.
What is shown in callout number 1 in the gear alignment diagram?
Callout number 1 indicates the switching gear that must be aligned with the control gear.
What is the first step in removing the sunroof motor/gear unit?
Detach the clamping strip as the first step in the removal process.
What tool is required for manual sunroof operation?
A socket wrench is required to turn the drive shaft for manual operation.
What additional work is required when replacing the microswitch?
When replacing the microswitch, you must remove and install the motor/gear unit per procedure 54 13 010, and drill out hollow rivets and rivet on the new motor switch.
What is the procedure number for replacing left or right gate for sun roof?
The procedure number is 54 12 250.
What bolts need to be unscrewed during the gate replacement procedure?
Unscrew bolts, then unscrew left and right bolts.
What should be done with the cable after pulling it out of the guide?
Press gate (1) off of drive cable (2).
What maintenance should be performed on the slides during reassembly?
Transfer and lubricate slides with grease.
What type of lubricant is specified for the slides?
Grease is specified for lubricating the slides.
What is the HWB number referenced at the bottom of the page?
The HWB number is 81 22 9 407 171.
What is the procedure number for removing and installing the sun roof winder?
The procedure number is 54 12 020.
What should you avoid doing when closing the sun roof lid?
Do not lift the lid when closing the sun roof lid to the pressure point.
What are the steps to remove the sun roof winder escutcheon?
Unscrew the bolt and remove the escutcheon.
What components are shown in image 730 54 039?
The image shows the sun roof winder mechanism with the escutcheon being removed.
Which direction should the large opening (A) face during installation?
The large opening (A) faces rear during installation.
What is shown in image 730 54 041?
The image shows the proper orientation of the winder mechanism with the large opening (A) facing rear during installation.
What procedure must be performed before removing the recess plate?
Remove and install the sun roof winder (54 12 020) before removing the recess plate.
How do you remove the recess plate for the sun roof winder?
Unscrew the bolts and remove the recess plate.
What is the reference number for the image showing the recess plate removal?
The reference number is 730 54 042.
What is the procedure code for replacing the convertible top canvas?
The procedure code is 54 31 020 for replacing top (canvas).
What should be done with the rivets and window guide during removal?
Drill out rivets and pull off window guide.
What needs to be done to the rubber seal and rail during disassembly?
Pull off rubber seal and unscrew rail.
How should the rail be handled during installation?
During installation, replace screws when reinstalling the rail.
What remains on the cable when unscrewing the rail?
The rail remains on the cable when unscrewed.
What should be replaced during rail installation?
Replace screws during installation.
How should the top be removed from the frame?
Pull top off of frame, disconnect cable and pull it out together with the rail forward.
What cleaning procedure is specified for the frame and hoopsticks?
Clean frame and hoopsticks with a solvent to remove residual adhesive.
What should be done after pulling the top off the frame and hoopsticks?
After pulling the top off the frame and hoopsticks, clean the frame and hoopsticks with a solvent to remove residual adhesive.
What type of cleaning agent is specified for removing adhesive residue?
A solvent is specified for removing residual adhesive from the frame and hoopsticks.
What BMW special tool is used to measure the distance from the side panel to the bearing surface of the top console?
Special Tool 00 2 550 is used to measure the distance from the side panel (lower edge of rail) to the bearing surface of the top console at both threaded pins.
What should the distance measurement be for the front threaded pin?
The distance A should be 181 mm (7.126 inches) for the front threaded pin.
How do you initially position the convertible top for adjustment?
Place rails on left and right side panels, ensuring the rails must bear on metal and pull off the rubber partially.
What thickness of shims are available for distance adjustment?
Shims are available in thicknesses of 1 mm (0.039 inches) thick.
What is the proper way to hold the top during adjustment?
Hold the top with nuts (1) - it must still be possible to move the top.
How do you adjust the distance on the front mounting points?
Close the top and adjust distance B on the front mounting points with shims (2), which are available in thicknesses of 1 mm (0.039 inches). Then tighten the top nuts.
What callout number indicates the nuts used to hold the top?
Callout number (1) indicates the nuts used to hold the top during adjustment.
What callout number shows the shims used for adjustment?
Callout number (2) indicates the shims used for adjusting the distance on the front mounting points.
What is the final step in the top adjustment procedure?
Center the top to the side panels.
Where are the shims placed during the adjustment procedure?
The shims are placed on the front mounting points to adjust distance B.
What must be verified about the top's movement during the holding procedure?
It must still be possible to move the top while holding it with the nuts.
What should I do if I hear rattling noise from the sunroof?

Check for maladjusted sunroof, guide tubes knocking against each other, roof liner frame knocking against sun roof lid when open, connector for water drain knocking on guide rail, or too much play of sliding shoes and upper guiding pin. Corrections include adjusting the sun roof, wrapping tape around guide tubes, pasting foam rubber on corners of sun roof frame, pasting tape on rivets and guide linkage, or see Service Information 54 01 84 (298).
Why would the sun roof lift but not slide?
This condition is caused by pins on gate holders being bent. The correction is to replace the gate holders.
What causes the sun roof to lift onesidedly?

The sun roof lifts onesidedly due to drive cables being maladjusted in position 0 or rear guide turns on drive cable. To correct this, adjust drive cables in position 0 and lock drive cable in front of and behind guide with punch marks or by squeezing.
How do I fix grinding noise when opening and closing the sunroof?
Grinding noise when opening and closing is caused by sliding rails and plastic parts being lubricated. The correction is to remove grease and/or replace sliding shoes.
What should I check if there's grinding noise when lifting the sunroof?
Check for front seal being dry or excessive contact force on front seal. The corrections are to lubricate the seal with vaseline or adjust the lid.
What are the possible causes of water leaking through the roof liner area?

Water leaking through roof liner area can be caused by: sun roof maladjusted in position 0, seals loose/damaged, wrong seal installed (front/rear seals differ in shape), drain hoses plugged, guide rails and cover plates seal insufficiently on roof frame, corners in rear roof opening leak, or hose outlets plugged with sealing compound foam.
How do I correct water leaking issues in the sunroof?

Corrections for water leaking include: adjust sun roof in position 0, paste/replace seals, install original spare parts, clean drain hoses, seal guide rails and cover plates, seal corners, or clean hoses.
Where can I find additional service information for sunroof sliding shoe problems?
For issues with too much play of sliding shoes and upper guiding pin, see Service Information 54 01 84 (298).
What's the specific position mentioned for drive cable adjustment?
The drive cables should be adjusted in position 0. This position is mentioned for both maladjusted drive cables and sun roof adjustment procedures.
What type of lubricant should be used on the front seal?
Use vaseline to lubricate the front seal when it's dry and causing grinding noise during lifting.
How far should the sun roof lid be closed during installation?
Close sun roof lid but for about 5 cm (2").
What special tools are required to unscrew the bolts on the left and right sides of the sun roof lid?
Special Tools 00 2 102/103 are required to unscrew the bolts on left and right sides.
What procedure is referenced for removing and installing the sun roof lid?
Remove and install sun roof lid 54 12 100.
What should you adjust during sun roof installation?
Adjust sun roof 54 12 004 and replace self-locking bolts.
What are the two types of velvet strips used for sealing the sun roof lid?
V = Short front velvet strip (sealing lip faces forward) and H = Long rear velvet strip.
What should be done to avoid rattling noise when connecting rods are present?
Use a piece of tape on both sides in area of rivets (to avoid rattling noise).
What components need to be unscrewed to remove the roof liner frame?
Unscrew screws on left and right sides, remove cover rails (1) and guide pins (2).
How should the cables be handled during roof liner frame removal?
Pull cables out of guides, pull roof liner frame forward and remove. If applicable, unrivet and rivet connecting rods (3).
What marking system is used to identify left and right guide pins?
Guide pins (2) are marked with L for left or R for right.
What should be done with the roof liner frame after removing the cover rails?
Pull roof liner frame forward uniformly and open sun roof lid slightly while holding roof liner frame by hand.
What type of bolts should be used during sun roof installation?
Replace self-locking bolts during installation.
How should the holding clamps be positioned during installation?
Press in holding clamps for front roof liner frame.
What is the required distance adjustment between the hardtop and body?
The distance between hardtop and body should be adjusted to 5 to 6 mm (0.197 to 0.236 inches).
What tool is needed for locking the knurled nut according to the diagram?
Special Tool 51 3 170 is needed for locking the knurled nut.
What are the first steps when preparing to install the hardtop?
Wind down side windows completely, fold in the top, close the top lid, and pull out plug (1).
What do the numbered callouts 1, 2, and 3 represent in the locking mechanism diagram?
1 is the locking screw, 2 is the knurled nut for locking with Special Tool 51 3 170, and 3 is the adjusting screw.
How should the locking screw be operated to engage the front locks?
Turn the locking screw with an open-end ring wrench until the lock is noticed to engage, then engage the front locks.
What should be done with the covers for rear fasteners on the hardtop?
Fold down covers for rear fasteners on the hardtop.
What special considerations are noted for hardtop take-ups installation?
Connect lead (1) for rear window defogger, screw on left and right hardtop take-ups with three screws (2 to 4), lock bolts with Loctite, and lubricate slip contacts with light coat of contact grease.
Where should the hardtop be mounted according to the installation procedure?
Mount hardtop with pins in the take-ups.
What lubricant specification is mentioned for the slip contacts?
Lubricate slip contacts with light coat of contact grease.
What thread locking compound is specified for the hardtop installation?
Lock bolts with Loctite.
What does callout number 4 indicate in the hardtop take-up installation diagram?
Callout number 4 indicates one of the screws used to secure the hardtop take-ups (screws 2, 3, and 4 are used for installation).
What is the purpose of connecting lead (1) during hardtop take-up installation?
Lead (1) should be connected for the rear window defogger operation.
What ratio should cement and hardener be mixed in for hardtop repairs?
Mix cement and hardener in a ratio of 15 to 1.
What tool should be used to cut out repair patches from the roof skin?
Use a saddler's knife to cut out patches and roof skin together at right angles to the surface being repaired.
How long should you allow for drying time after applying the mixed cement?
Allow about 15 minutes drying time for the cement.
What should be used to repair damaged points in the honeycomb structure?
Repair damaged points in the honeycomb structure with a fiber filler and harden with ultraviolet light.
What concentration of alcoholic solution should be used to clean the hardtop?
Clean the hardtop with an alcoholic solution (2%) or watery solution on soap basis.
How should patches be applied after the cement has dried?
Apply patches with edges butted and press on firmly with a rubber roller.
What material should be used to coat the butt edges and how should it be applied?
Dip a glass rod in Plastisol and coat the butt edges thoroughly.
What happens if damage is deeper in the honeycomb structure?
If damage is deeper, apply the filler in layers and harden with ultraviolet light.
How long should you allow for drying time after coating the butt edges?
Allow about 15 minutes drying time for the butt edges (dust dry).
What important step should be taken regarding excess cement during patch application?
If applicable, remove any cement squeezed out on the sides (don't smear it!).
What is the final step in the hardtop repair procedure?
Paint part of or the entire hardtop with clear lacquer.
What must be done to prepare the repair surface before applying filler?
Remove old cement and clean the repair surface, then grind and clean the repair surface.
What size hexagon key is needed for installation of the guide pin holder?
4 mm hexagon key
How are the drive cables marked to indicate left and right sides?
Drive cables are marked L = left or R = right.
What should you do first when replacing the drive cables?
Remove and install sun roof lid 54 12 100, then remove and install recess plate 54 12 050.
Where should the guide pins be inserted during installation?
Place guide pins on left and right sides and insert in holes of operating lever and gate.
What should be done to the gear mounting bolts if needed?
If applicable, loosen gear mounting bolts further to make drive cables accessible.
How do you remove the drive cables from the guide tubes?
Pull drive cables out of guide tubes.
What components need to be removed to access the drive cables?
Remove cover rails and guide pins. Guide pins are marked L = left or R = right.
What should be done with the gear after installation?
Set gear to 0 (pressure point) and tighten bolts.
What does callout number 2 indicate in the drive cable diagram?
The drive cable
What is the first step shown in the bolt removal procedure?
Loosen bolt, then unscrew left and right bolts.
What special lubricant should be used when mounting the rail and pulling in the rubber seal?
A special lubricant should be used, as indicated by the asterisk reference in the instructions.
How should the window guide be secured into the rail?
Slide the window guide into the rail using a special lubricant, then secure it with a rivet and cement the side on the frame.
What are the two main steps shown for mounting the rail?
First, slide the window guide into the rail using special lubricant and secure with rivet and cement. Second, mount the rail and pull in the rubber seal using special lubricant.
What should be done after cementing the banner?
Mount the rail and pull in the rubber seal using special lubricant.
What component is being cemented in the second image?
The banner is being cemented, and then the rail is mounted and the rubber seal is pulled in.
What is the final step shown in the procedure?
Close the top by cementing the top on hoopsticks, beginning with the short banner.
What method is used to secure the window guide to the frame?
The window guide is secured with a rivet and cement on the side of the frame.
Where should you begin when cementing the top on hoopsticks?
Begin with the short banner when cementing the top on hoopsticks.
What is the source reference indicated at the bottom of the page?
The source reference is HWB, as indicated by the asterisk at the bottom of the page.
What type of seal is used with the rail mounting procedure?
A rubber seal is used and should be pulled in during the rail mounting procedure using special lubricant.
What section number covers instruments in this manual?
Section 62 covers Instruments.
What is the main topic covered in section 62?
Section 62 covers Instruments.
What page range contains information about the simulator for testing instrument clusters?
Information about the simulator for testing instrument clusters can be found on pages 62-81.
What page number is shown at the top of this index page?
Page 73 is shown at the top of this index page.
How many specific topics are listed under the Instruments section on this index page?
Only one specific topic is listed: Simulator for testing instrument clusters.
What happens to the green LEDs after performing an OIL SERVICE reset?
All five green LEDs will come on after making an OIL SERVICE reset, regardless of whether one green LED was still on or only the yellow OIL SERVICE sign was showing.
When do the yellow and INSPECTION symbol lamps come on during the service indicator reset process?
The yellow and INSPECTION symbol lamps will come on when the green LEDs have gone out again.
How many green LEDs are mentioned in the service indicator reset procedure?
Five green LEDs are mentioned in the service indicator reset procedure.
Does the OIL SERVICE reset behavior depend on the initial state of the service indicators?

No, the OIL SERVICE reset behavior does not depend on the initial state - all five green LEDs will come on regardless of whether one green LED was still on or only the yellow OIL SERVICE sign was showing.
What section and page numbers are shown at the top of this page?
This is page 62 - 87 from the service manual.
What is the title of section 2.2.3?
LEDs and Light Bulbs for SI Signs (Not with 2nd Generation SI).
Which BMW series cars are mentioned for the first procedure?
'3' Series Cars are mentioned for connecting the printed circuit board.
What should happen when you connect the printed circuit board on '3' Series cars?
All LEDs and both light bulbs must come on.
What is the expected result when connecting the plug on '5', '6' and '7' series cars?
All LEDs and both signs must light up.
What component is being tested in both procedures shown?
The printed circuit board is being tested in both procedures.
What are the reference numbers for the two images shown?
The top image is labeled 30 62 092 and the bottom image is labeled 30 62 053.
What visual indication confirms proper operation in the '3' Series test?
All LEDs and both light bulbs coming on confirms proper operation.
What visual indication confirms proper operation in the '5', '6' and '7' Series test?
All LEDs and both signs lighting up confirms proper operation.
What type of generation SI system is excluded from this procedure?
The 2nd Generation SI system is excluded from this procedure.
What appears to be shown in the circular diagnostic images?
The images show the printed circuit board connection points with arrows indicating where to connect for testing LEDs and light bulbs.
What is the caution when mounting the plug connection plate on the instrument cluster?
Be careful not to bend spring contacts when mounting the connection plate.
Which wire harness plugs should be connected to the instrument cluster for '5', '6' and '7' series cars?
Connect blue and white plugs of wire harness on instrument cluster.
What is the minimum battery voltage required for the simulator red control lamp to come on?
The red control lamp will not come on with a battery voltage of less than 11.5 V; the simulator is not ready for use.
How should the selector switch be set when checking the speedometer?
Set selector switch (3) to km/h or mph, and turn knob (7) against left stop; speedometer needle points to 0.
What happens when you turn knob 7 clockwise slowly during speedometer testing?
The speedometer needle passes through the display range.
What is the display range that the simulator is designed for on speedometers?
The simulator is designed for speedometers with a display range of 280 km/h.
How should the simulator be connected to a 12V battery?
Connect red terminal (3) on B + and black terminal (4) on B - of a 12 V battery. Turn on simulator with switch (1).
What callout numbers are shown in the top diagram of the instrument cluster?
The top diagram shows callout numbers 1 and 2 indicating components of the plug connection plate installation.
Where can the set frequency be measured on the simulator?
The set frequency can be measured on the yellow jack with a BMW service test unit (multimeter 14).
What are the FREQ terminals and their connection colors?
Yellow connection terminal FREQ in + in yellow jack; Black connection terminal FREQ in - on B - of battery.
What could happen if a speedometer has a smaller display range than 280 km/h?

If the display range is smaller, after reaching the final display value and increasing frequency with knob (7) the needle would fall back to an undefined display value, then start from this display value and pass through the display range again.
What should be referenced for test values when using the simulator?
See Specifications for test values.
What are the two main instrument procedures covered in section 62 13 000?
Removing and installing tachometer and removing and installing clock.
What is the first step when removing the tachometer?
Remove and install instrument carrier assembly 62 21 000, then unscrew screws.
After unscrewing the screws for tachometer removal, what should be done next?
Take instruments with carrier out of housing.
What models does the clock removal procedure apply to?
What is the first step for removing the clock?
Disconnect retaining straps.
What should be done after removing the trim for clock removal?
Pull off plug on clock, unscrew screws, and remove clock.
What diagram shows the instrument carrier assembly components?
Diagram 30 62 012 shows the instrument carrier assembly with various screws and mounting points indicated by arrows.
What is shown in diagram 30 62 013?
The diagram shows instruments with carrier being taken out of housing and the instrument cluster components.
What does diagram 30 62 020 illustrate?
It shows the step to unscrew screws during the tachometer removal process.
What is the reference number for the instrument carrier assembly procedure?
62 21 000 is referenced for the remove and install instrument carrier assembly procedure.
What should I check if Term. 30 s electric power supply is not okay?
Check wire to fuse F 5, check fuse F 5 replacing with 8 ampere fuse if necessary, and check power rail in central electric board for fuse F 5.
What fuse controls the Term. 15 electric power supply with ignition turned on?
Fuse F 6 controls the Term. 15 electric power supply with ignition turned on.
What additional check is required for Term. 15 power supply beyond checking the fuse?
Check wire from fuse F 6 to ignition lock term. 15.
What bridge connection should be checked for Term. R electric power supply?
Check bridge between fuse F 8 and fuse F 11.
What amperage fuse should be used to replace fuse F 8 if necessary?
Replace with 8 ampere fuse if necessary.
What terminal connection should be checked for Term. R power supply?
Check wire from fuse F 11 to ignition lock term. R.
What should be done if Term. 31 ground connection is not okay?
Check ground wire, replacing if necessary.
Which pin on the blue instrument cluster plug should be checked for the central warning lamp?
Check wire from check control term ZH to pin 9 of blue instrument cluster plug.
What signal frequency can be measured on pin 9 of the blue instrument cluster plug?
A ground signal of 1 Hz can be measured on pin 9 of blue instrument cluster plug with turn signal on.
What resistance values should the transmitter in oil pan show when tested?
0 ohm static and 1 k-ohm dynamic.
What should I do if the transmitter in oil pan shows incorrect resistance values?
Apply extra ground wire or replace transmitter.
How do I test the coolant/washing fluid level sensors?
Check coolant/washing fluid level sensors with ohmmeter - 0 ohm. Okay?
What should I do if the coolant and washing fluid levels are not okay?
Add coolant and/or washing fluid with pertinent antifreeze concentration.
What is the corrective action if the coolant/washing fluid level sensors don't show 0 ohm?
Repair ground wire. Replace transmitters.
What should I check if the transmitter wire plug connection is not okay?
Repair or replace transmitter.
How do I test power flow in wires from transmitter to check control?
Check power flow in wires from transmitter to check control static oil term. and dyn. oil terminal. Okay?
What should I do if there's no power flow in the wires from transmitters to check control terminals KW and WW?
Repair or replace wires.
What is the final step if all other checks pass for both engine oil and coolant/washing fluid systems?
Check plug connections of check control. Replace check control.
What is the first step when troubleshooting stop light problems?
Check both stop lights to see if they are working okay.
If both stop lights are not working, what should you check first?
Check if power supply from ignition lock terminal R to fuse F 12 is okay.
What fuse should be checked if there's no power from the ignition lock terminal?
Replace the 8 ampere fuse if it's blown.
Where do you check for voltage when testing the stop light switch?
Check voltage in wire from stop light switch inlet to check control terminal 54 Si7.
What terminal is used for the ground connection when testing the bulb tester?
Terminal 31 (ground) on bulb tester.
If the voltage is not okay from the stop light switch outlet to bulb tester terminal 54, what should you do?
Check wires.
What should you check if the voltage is not okay on bulb tester outlet terminals 54 L and 54 R?
Replace bulb tester.
What is the final step if the wires from bulb tester to stop lights are not okay?
Supply electric power and check wires and plugs.
If the ground wires to stop lights are not okay, what corrective action should be taken?
Make ground connections and replace light bulbs if necessary.
What button number is used to adjust the SI?
The SI can be adjusted with button (10).
How long does the SI run off at intervals when pressing button 10?
The SI runs off at intervals of about 10 seconds by pressing button (10).
How many oil services does the BMW 524 td have between each inspection?
The BMW 524 td has two OIL SERVICES between each inspection.
What happens when you perform a brief reset (8) on the oil service indicator?
Brief reset (8) will cancel the display. All five green LEDs come on.
How do you reset the inspection indicator and what happens?
Resetting 'INSPECTION' shows the 'INSPECTION' sign and yellow (possibly red) LED on. Long reset (9) will cancel the display.
What is the effect of a long reset (9) on the time counter?
The time counter is not influenced! Time counter can be reset with a second reset (9).
How do you reset the time symbol and distance counter?
Long reset (9) will cancel the time symbol and time counter. Distance counter can be reset with a second reset (9).
What visual indicators show when resetting the 'TIME SYMBOL'?
'TIME SYMBOL' and one or more green LEDs on. Green LEDs are not influenced!
What must be removed first when removing the speedometer?
Remove and install instrument carrier assembly 62 21 000.
What is the first step shown in the speedometer removal procedure?
Unscrew screws.
After unscrewing the screws, what is the next step in the removal process?
Take instruments with carrier out of housing.
How many main steps are involved in removing the speedometer?
Three main steps: unscrew screws, take instruments with carrier out of housing, and unscrew bolt.
What arrows are visible in diagram 30 62 012?
Multiple arrows pointing to the screws that need to be unscrewed.
What wire color is used for the ignition key in 'R' position signal on pin 1 'R'?
The wire color for pin 1 'R' Terminal 'R' is violet/gray.
How do you test the central warning lamp circuit on pin 2 'ZHL'?
Connect pin 2 with pin 9 (-) to activate the central warning lamp continuously. The wire color is brown/yellow and it functions when ignition is turned on.
What is the expected test result for pin 3 'OH' (Japan) Overheat when testing with a voltmeter?
Pin 3 (-) to voltmeter to pin 4 (+) should equal UB. This circuit is only for E 28 and on pin 5 for E 24/E 23.
Which pins are used for air bag testing and what are their designations?
Pin 6 'AB' (USA) Air bag (+) and pin 7 'AB' (USA) Air bag (-) are used for air bag testing.
What wire color identifies the oxygen sensor circuit?
The oxygen sensor circuit on pin 5 'OX' (USA) uses blue/white wire color.
How do you test the fasten seat belts warning system?
Test pin 8 'FS' (USA) Fasten seat belts with brown/violet wire. Test pin 8 (-) to voltmeter to pin 4 (+) should equal UB when ignition is turned on.
What is the ground reference point for check control testing?
Pin 9 '31' Terminal '31' with brown wire color serves as the ground reference point.
What does the green/white wire on pin 4 '15' control?
The green/white wire on pin 4 '15' Terminal '15' functions when ignition is turned on.
How should you set up the voltmeter connections for testing most check control input signals?
Most tests require connecting the negative voltmeter lead to the specified pin (-) and the positive lead to either pin 4 (+), pin 9 (-), or pin 15 (+) depending on the circuit being tested.
Which wire colors are used for pin 23 '5ASI' Fuse monitor?
Violet/white
What is the expected ohm reading for pin 24 '54KL' Stop light indicator when tested to pin 9?
= 4.7 ohms
What function does pin 25 '54' with green/red wire colors serve?
Brakes applied, stop lights okay
When testing pin 26 'KKL' License plate light indicator, what resistance should I measure between it and pin 9?
= 4.7 ohms
What is the wire color combination for the Low beam indicator (pin 22 'K')?
Yellow/black
Which pins show the same 4.7 ohms resistance value when tested to pin 9?
Pin 24 '54KL' Stop light indicator and Pin 26 'KKL' License plate light indicator
What does the green LED (4) indicate in the service indicator system?
The green LED (4) indicates the 100 meter pulse required for the service indicator (SI) and economy control (EC). The LED must come on and go out in 100 meter intervals (not for final display value).
What position should the selector switch be set to for tachometer testing?
Turn selector switch (3) to 1/min (rpm) position. Turn knob (7) against the left stop; tachometer needle points to 0.
What are the tachometer settings for different engine types?
6 cylinder engines = 6 cyl, 4 cylinder engines = 4 cyl, diesel engines = Diesel. Turn switch (5) to correct position for the engine type being tested.
How should the tachometer needle be adjusted during testing?
Turn knob (7) clockwise slowly; tachometer needle moves through the display range. If the green LEDs are still on at the beginning of the test, cancel them when the speed exceeds approx. 500 rpm.
What is the maximum display range for the tachometer simulator?

The simulator is designed for a tachometer with a display range of 8,000 1/min (rpm). In case of tachometers with a display range of 5,000 1/min (rpm), the needle will fall back to an undefined display value after reaching the final display value.
Where can the set frequency be measured for the economy control system?
The set frequency can be measured on the yellow jack with a BMW Service Tester (multimeter 14) - see operating instructions of BMW Service Tester.
What selector switch position is used for Economy Control (EC) testing?
Turn selector switch (3) to L/100 km or MPG position. Press and hold button pressed on connecting plate (only with 2nd generation SI).
What are the connection terminals for frequency measurement?
Yellow connection terminal FREQ in + in yellow jack; black connection terminal FREQ in - on B - of battery.
Which SI generation does the green LED function NOT apply to?
The green LED function is not applicable to 2nd generation SI.
What happens if the tachometer frequency is increased beyond the display range?
If the frequency is increased even more, the needle will move through the display range again from this display value on.
Where can I find information about troubleshooting the check control system?
Page 62-71

62 16 000, and it references Group 16
What are the wire colors for pin 11 '58R' Tail lights right?

What is the expected test value when checking pin 13 '58KL' with an ohmmeter?

Which pins are listed as 'Not used' on this connector diagram?

Pin 15 '30' Terminal '30' provides positive from terminal 30 via fuse number.

What test equipment is specified for checking the tail light circuits?

Which fluid level sensors show an approximate 0 ohm reading when tested?

What will the fuel consumption display show when the car is stopped but the engine is running?
EC will always display infinite fuel consumption when idling (car stopped - engine running).
What should the fuel consumption display show during coasting with no fuel injection?
The display will be close to zero in the coasting phase with coasting shutoff, i.e. no fuel injection.
What could cause an unrealistic display showing only 6 liters in 4th gear at full load?
This could be caused by a wrong or broken coding plug.
How do you fix a coding plug issue with the fuel consumption display?
Check/replace coding plug (see Specifications).
What are the possible causes when the EC display shows excessive fuel consumption?
Wrong temperature on quartz or coding plug wrong.
What correction is needed if the fuel consumption display shows no reading at all?
Check injection signal on instrument cluster plug (blue) pin 2, check plug connection, or replace tachometer with economy control.
What causes the display needle to wander when the car is idling?
Disturbance from term. 1
How do you fix display needle wandering in idle condition?
Disconnect black wire of term. 1 on instrument cluster plug, pull out wire in wire harness and wrap it around the wire harness.
What causes the display needle to wander when switching on lights or operating the headlight flasher?
Disturbance from dimmer relay.
What part number relay should be used to fix dimmer relay disturbance?
Replace low beam (dimmer) relay. Only install a diode relay, Part No. 61 31 1 373 154.
What selector switch position is required for the temperature gage function?
Selector switch (3) should be set to temperature.
How should knob 7 be positioned to set the temperature gage to the blue range?
Turn knob (7) against left stop; needle of temperature gage is in blue range.

Needle deflection takes place only in last third of turning range for knob (7).
What selector switch position is needed for fuel gage operation?
Selector switch (3) set to tank.
How do you position the fuel gage needle to point to R?
Turn knob (7) against left stop; needle of fuel gage points to R.
How long must you press and hold the starting button to simulate car engine starting?
Press and hold starting button (6) at least two seconds before releasing.
What happens to the green LEDs when the Service Indicator is turned on?
The LEDs of SI begin to light up several seconds after switching on (switch at ON). The green LEDs go out when reaching a speed of approx. 600 rpm.
What are the two reset functions available with buttons 8 and 9?
Button 8: OIL SERVICE reset, Button 9: INSPECTION reset.
How is the time of resetting indicated on the Service Indicator?
The time of resetting is indicated by a lamp in the pertinent button.
What callout number indicates the selector switch in the diagrams?
Callout number 3 indicates the selector switch.
What happens when the simulator is switched off and on again regarding the LEDs?
LEDs are turned on again each time the simulator is switched off and on again afterwards.
How can the pertinent interval be cancelled on the Service Indicator?
The pertinent interval will be cancelled by pressing a button briefly.

Take the instruments with carrier out of the housing.

Unscrew nut and remove temperature gauge.
How should the temperature gauge be installed?

How should the fuel gauge be installed?

What diagram numbers are shown for removing the instruments from the housing?

Connect the blue and white plugs of the wire harness on the instrument cluster for both '3' Series Cars and Second Generation Service Indicator models.

Be careful not to bend the spring contacts when mounting the connection plate.

Connect the red terminal (3) on B+ and black terminal (4) on B- of a 12 V battery.

What are the lead connections needed on the simulator itself?

Which BMW models does this instrument cluster checking procedure apply to?

What should you secure the connection plate with?

Check the power supply from terminal 30 via fuses F 22 and F 23, each 7.5 amps, to the light switch terminals 58 LE and 58 RE.

Supply electric power and replace the fuse.

Check the light switch by measuring voltage on the outlet to terminals 58 R and 58 L.
What resistance value should you measure in the bulb tester from terminal 31 to terminal 58 KL with lights on?
The resistance should be 4.7 ohms in the bulb tester from terminal 31 to terminal 58 KL with lights on.

What should the fuel tank level be when aiming headlights?

How should headlight adjustment be performed relative to tolerance ranges?

Remove cover (1).

On 1988 models, open the fastener and lift out the cover.
Which bulb position in the tail light assembly is used for the backup light?
Position 5 is used for the backup light.
How many stop light bulbs are there in each tail light assembly?

What should you disconnect first when beginning heater core removal?

Drain coolant.

What angle does the temperature control regulate the water valve at?

At what coolant temperature does the valve close when the temperature control is set to < 20° C?
The valve will be closed when the temperature control is set to < 20° C (68° F).
What are the high pressure switch operating parameters for the A/C compressor?

The high pressure switch stops the compressor when reaching a coolant pressure of 25.5 to 17.7 bar (363 to 252 psi) and switches the compressor on again when coolant pressure drops to 22.5 to 20 bar (320 to 284 psi).
What are the low pressure switch operating parameters?

The low pressure switch stops the compressor when coolant pressure drops to 2.22 to 1.72 bar (32 to 24 psi) and switches the compressor on again when coolant pressure rises to 2.0 to 2.4 bar (28 to 34).
How many speeds does the air volume control switch operate the blower at?
The air volume control switch operates the blower in 3 speeds via fixed resistors, which are located in the heater.
What happens to the additional electric fan when the air conditioner is switched on?
When the air conditioner is switched on, the additional 2-speed electric fan always runs at least in 1st speed.

What happens to the refrigerant when the compressor increases its pressure?
When the compressor increases the pressure of gaseous refrigerant (Friqon), the refrigerant temperature automatically rises as well.
What is the function of component number 3 in the air conditioning system?
Component 3 is the condenser, where the refrigerant puts off heat and is condensed (turns into a liquid).
What are the two safety switches in the system and what do they prevent?
Safety switches 5 and 6 stop the compressor when pressure is too high or too low, preventing damage to the air conditioning system.
What component meters the amount of refrigerant injected into the evaporator?
Expansion valve (7) meters the amount of refrigerant which is injected into evaporator (8).
What happens to the liquid refrigerant in the evaporator?
The liquid refrigerant expands in evaporator (8) and is turned into gas, which produces strong cooling of the refrigerant and evaporator.
Why does the freezing prevention switch activate the compressor?
Freezing prevention switch (9) switches the compressor to prevent the formation of ice on the evaporator, as ice formation would reduce the cross section opening size and impair cooling efficiency.
What happens to moisture in the fresh air circulation?
Moisture in the fresh air condenses on the evaporator and is discharged outside of car via lines on the transmission tunnel. This water is normal and not a sign of leakage.
What is component number 4 and what does it do?
Component 4 is the drier, which removes residual water from the refrigerant and absorbs it.

Component 10 is high pressure gas, component 11 is high pressure liquid, and component 12 is low pressure liquid.
What determines the amount of refrigerant that the expansion valve injects into the evaporator?

What should you do if refrigerant gets on your skin?
Refrigerant on the skin will cause frostbite. Wash off pertinent parts of body with cold water thoroughly.
What should you do if refrigerant gets in your eyes?
If refrigerant gets in the eyes, rinse out with water and then contact a physician immediately.
Why should refrigerants not be discharged in closed rooms?

Refrigerants are heavier than air and therefore should not be discharged in closed rooms. Especially in working pits there would be an acute danger of asphyxiation, which would not be noticeable since the gas has no color or odor.
What is the maximum storage temperature for full refrigerant cylinders?
Store full refrigerant cylinders so they are not subjected to direct sunshine or other sources of heat with a maximum temperature of 45°C / 113°F.
Can you perform welding work on a discharged air conditioner?
Never perform welding work on a discharged air conditioner or in the vicinity. The pressure which would occur could lead to an explosion.
What are the major procedures listed for discharging and charging the air conditioner?
The major procedures are: 1) Connecting charging equipment, 2) Discharging, 3) Flushing with refrigerant, 4) Discharging, 5) Charging with refrigerant, and 6) Checking function of air conditioner.
What happens to refrigerants at high temperatures or when exposed to open flame?
Refrigerants decompose at high temperatures or when exposed to an open flame. The decomposed products are injurious to health.

Motor running.

Defect in relay box, activation of interlock defective, wires, or BC II.

Set ignition lock in R or 15. Pin 10 (= B-) connected briefly with pin 4 several times: Information in display must change each time.

Steering column switch defective, wires, or BC II.

Coding plug, reserve volume balance, speed signal, consumption signal, or fuel level transmitter/reserve contact.
Which points should I reference for driving range function problems?
See point 1 for coding plug, point 6 for reserve volume balance, and point 7 for speed and consumption signals.
What should I check if the fuel gauge display in the instrument cluster is incorrect?
Check the connection from instrument cluster to BC II and check wires to instrument cluster.
When BC II needs to be replaced, which point should I reference?
Replace BC II (see point 1).
What specific test involves connecting pins 11 and 10 with B-?
Testing the starter interlocking relay activation - connect pin 11 and pin 10 (= B-) and turn ignition lock to R or 15, and the relay in relay box must operate.

Lift and slide console forward.

The parking brake cover.

Install console from installation kit.

Turn on ignition.

Insert cable (1) in holders (2) until spring retainer (3) engages. The cable holder is guided into the cable.

The antenna wire (1) should be plugged into the jack of the radio.

Guide in plastic cable and telescope by hand at same time.

Ohmmeter should display 0 ohm.

Ohmmeter (M 06).

Check wires, repairing if necessary.

Repair or replace plugs and wires if they are not okay.

What is the operating speed range of the electronic cruise control system?
The electronic cruise control operates in a range from approximately 45 km/h (28 mph) to almost top speed.
What tolerance does the cruise control system maintain for the stored road speed?
The system regulates the car's speed to a stored road speed with a tolerance of approximately 2 km/h (1 mph).
At what percentage below the set road speed does the cruise control system stop operating?
The system stops when the actual road speed drops below the set road speed by about 15%.
What happens when the actual road speed increases by 6 to 8 km/h over the set speed?
A quick action clutch opens and the throttle moves into idle position. The clutch closes and the system operates again when the car reaches the set road speed.
How should the gap (A) be adjusted with the throttle closed and operating motor unactivated?
With throttle closed and operating motor unactivated (engine running at idle speed), adjust gap (A) to 1 to 2 mm (0.040 to 0.080 inches) on knurled nut (1).
