What does the 'Brief Tipping to CONSTANT (4)' function do?
Instantaneous road speed is maintained and stored in memory.
What happens when holding the lever in CONSTANT position?
Car accelerates until desired road speed is reached; release lever. Reached road speed is maintained and stored in memory.
What occurs when pulling the lever to CALL (2) position?
The control unit accelerates car to a previously stored road speed when lever is pulled in CALL direction.
How is the cruise control switched off and what happens to stored values?
Cruise control is switched off by moving the lever Up - Down OFF (1/3). Stored value is cancelled only after turning off the ignition.

What is the purpose of the 15% speed drop protection mentioned in the operation section?

What are the different ignition lock positions and their functions for the on-board computer?

0: No display background lighting, not possible to operate buttons. R: Display board illuminated, operation possible, code function free. 15: Same as R, however also distance/time/consumption functions, code function locked. 50: Same as 15, but in this case the starting interlock must only function 6 seconds after taking away the term. 50 signal.
What is the universal adapter HWB number and its associated connection pins?
Universal adapter HWB No. 81 12 9 425 091, with Conn. lead wire harness 26-pin 096 and Conn. lead control unit 26-pin 097.
How can you call the type of coding plug in ignition lock position 15?

The type of coding plug can be called in ignition lock position 15 by pressing buttons 1 and 100 simultaneously. If calling is not possible, check power supply between pins 10 (= B -) and 7 (= term. 15).
What should you do if PPPP appears in the display due to a problem in the coding plug on back?
Replace coding plug, disconnect power supply, reconnect, perform coding test.
What does AAAA appearing in the display indicate?
AAAA appears in display indicates an internal BC II defect. The solution is to replace BC II; also refer to point 1.
What voltage specification should be checked between pins 10 and 6 when there is no display?
When there is no display due to power supply missing, check between pin 10 (= B-) and pin 6 (= B+). Specification: U ≥ 10 V.
What causes a weak time display with no other operations possible in ignition lock position R?
This can be caused by no voltage on term. R or BC II defective (e.g. buttons). Check between pin 10 (= B-) and pin 5 (= term. R). Specification: U ≥ 10 V.
How is data stored in the on-board computer II cancelled?
Data stored in on board computer II is cancelled with the connecting switch of the test adapter (between BC II wire harness plug and BC II).
What should be checked regarding the fuel transmitter if BC II needs to be replaced?

After replacing BC II check coding and compensate reserve volume: If the tank volume does not equal reserve volume, pull the fuel level transmitter out of tank far enough that float is on bottom stop. Remove anti-tamper lock on BC II (left side next to button 1000). Ignition lock in position 15. Correct the displayed liter value with a screwdriver after pressing buttons 1 and 1000 simultaneously. Reinstall anti-tamper lock.
What is the diameter of the hole that needs to be drilled for the retractable antenna installation?
22 mm (0.866") dia. hole.
What are the two distances specified for marking the hole position?
Distance 1 = 50 mm (2") and Distance 2 = 25 mm (1").
What should be done to avoid damaging the paint finish during drilling?
Use tape in area of hole to avoid damaging the paint finish with burrs from drilling and to provide a better method of marking hole's position.
What are the first two steps in the retractable antenna installation procedure?
Remove jack and pull off side trim panel.
What should be done after making the hole but before final installation?

After making hole, pull off tape carefully toward hole to avoid taking off paint on edges of hole. Deburr hole and coat edges with zinc dust paint. Remove burrs on trunk floor plate - danger of producing rust.
What is the complete installation order for the antenna components?
1 = Nut, 2 = Adapter, 3 = Insulator, 4 = Side panel, rear, right, 5 = Seal, 6 = Brass ring, 7 = Antenna.

Don't tighten nut (1) completely at this point.
Where should the hole be punched and drilled?
Punch mark point of intersection and drill a 22 mm (0.866") dia. hole.
What is installed with the rubber grommet according to the diagram?
Install holder (1) with rubber grommet (2).
What should be used to clean seat belt straps?
Use a luke warm soap solution or commercial fire laundry detergent to clean seat belt straps. Seat belt straps may never be cleaned chemically or dyed.
When should an automatic seat belt be replaced?
Replace an automatic seat belt in case of creases, fringing, pinches, tears or cuts, melting, or seam damage on end of belt strap in area of holding or swinging fitting.
What happens when the 'PRESS' button is activated during seat belt fastening?
The insert must be ejected out of the lock by spring pressure when pressing the 'PRESS' button.
What spray should be used on seat belts and what is its purpose?
Spray a seat belt with universal spray, HWB No. 8 122 947 005, to improve retraction of belt in reel (reduces friction, especially on the belt reversing holder).
What component is labeled as item 1 in the seat belt mechanism diagram?
Item 1 indicates a deformed slide that has to be replaced.
When should the lower strap be replaced during seat belt service?
The lower strap must also be replaced when replacing a seat belt.
What is the proper way to insert the seat belt insert into the lock?
To fasten a seat belt the insert must be inserted in the lock lightly and heard to engage with a click.
What component is shown as item 16 in the belt opening diagram?
Item 16 shows the belt insert in the plastic sleeve of the belt opening.
When should the seat belt be replaced based on wear inspection?
The seat belt has to be replaced if traces of wear are found in the plastic sleeve of the belt opening above the belt insert.
What should be done if the lock trim is missing or damaged?
Replace the seat belt if the lock trim is missing or damaged.
What are straightening attempts on the seat and seat rail not approved for?
Straightening attempts on the seat and seat rail are not approved in the case of a seat-integrated seat belt where the stop of the lower strap could be deformed on the seat rail in a collision.
What type of damage is specifically illustrated in the seat belt inspection criteria?
Melting damage is specifically illustrated as one of the conditions requiring seat belt replacement.
How many independent activation systems does the automatic reel have for locking the belt?
The automatic reel has three independent activation systems for locking the belt.
What triggers the first activation system in the automatic seat belt?
The first activation system should lock the belt when driving fast in tight curves, in case of strong inclination (rolling over), full stop braking or collision. Ball (1) introduces this activation.
How should you test the first activation system of the automatic seat belt?

To check, set the seat backrest straight and take hold of the steering wheel with both hands in a supporting position. Then stop the car with full stop braking from a speed twice as fast as walking. The seat belt should lock.
What is the purpose of the second activation system in the automatic seat belt?
The second activation system is provided for additional safety and is controlled by inertia mass (2). This system is also okay, if the reel locks when pulling out the belt suddenly.
What does component (1) represent in the belt stopper diagram?
Component (1) is an eccentrically mounted friction roller that is moved against connector (2) and locks the belt.
What is the function of the belt stopper system?
The belt stopper is the third system and is provided to prevent the film winding effect occurring when the reel is locked and with strong deceleration.
When should the belt wind up on the reel automatically?
The belt should wind up on the reel automatically almost completely when taken off.
What should you do if the last section of the belt is not winding up?

It might be necessary to guide the last section of the belt to the door beam. If the last section is not wounding up, the return spring (3) could be weak or broken, or there might be excessive friction in the belt guides.
What must be done with a seat belt that has been worn in an accident?
A seat belt, which is no longer usable or had been worn in an accident, must be destroyed immediately after removal to make it impossible to use it again.
Does the automatic reel require servicing?
The automatic reel does not require servicing and must not be opened.
When must an automatic seat belt be replaced according to the mounting tab inspection?
An automatic seat belt must be replaced if mounting tab (6) is bent or the belt reversing holder is deformed in any (7).
What must be done to the front belt reversing holder after installation?
The front belt reversing holder must swing after installation.
What parts are needed to install the wind deflector for sun roof?
1 Wind deflector, 1 Rubber seal, 2 Flat head screws, 2 Knurled nuts, and 2 Holders.
What should you do with protruding ends when mounting the rubber seal on the wind deflector?
Cut off protruding ends if applicable.
How do you open the sun roof during wind deflector installation?
Press in holders between beaded edge and panel on left and right sides with a screwdriver.
How should the wind deflector be positioned relative to the roof opening?
Align wind deflector parallel to roof opening and tighten left and right screws uniformly.
When should the screws be retightened after initial installation?
Tighten screws uniformly after driving car approx. 100 km (60 miles).
What tool is mentioned for pressing in the holders during sun roof opening?
A screwdriver.
What is the driving distance specified before retightening the wind deflector screws?
Approximately 100 km (60 miles).
What type of screws are used to secure the wind deflector?
Flat head screws.
How many knurled nuts are required for the wind deflector installation?
2 knurled nuts.

The wind deflector with rubber seal mounted on it, showing where to cut off protruding ends.
Why is there a note about retightening screws after driving?
The screws need to be retightened uniformly after approximately 100 km (60 miles) of driving to ensure proper installation.
What should I do if the mounting tab on the belt reversing holder is deformed?
Replace the complete automatic seat belt.
What defects in the belt strap would require complete seat belt replacement?
Pinches, melt spots, cuts, creases, tears, and fringing in the fully pulled out belt strap.
If the seam on the end of the belt strap is damaged, what is the repair procedure?
Replace the complete automatic seat belt.
How do I test if the spring pressure mechanism is working correctly?
Check if spring pressure ejects the belt insert out of the lock when operating the 'PRESS' button while the seat belt is fastened.
What is the emergency braking test for automatic seat belts?
Check if a fastened seat belt locks when stopping a car from a speed twice as fast as walking with brakes applied fully.
Can dirt and spots on the belt strap be cleaned instead of replacing the belt?
The seat belt must be replaced if dirt and spots cannot be removed with a commercial fine laundry detergent.
What should I check if the front tongue of the reclining mechanism or seat rails are deformed?
Replace damaged parts and the complete automatic seat belt.
How do I diagnose seat belt lock switch problems?
Check switch in seat belt lock by measuring resistance on belt lock plug. Belt lock engaged should read ∞Ω, belt lock not engaged should read 0Ω.
What warning signal indicates a potential seat belt system problem?
A warning signal with the driver's door closed, seat belt fastened (click heard) and ignition turned on indicates a problem with the seat belt lock switch.
When is the automatic seat belt considered okay according to this flowchart?
The automatic seat belt is okay when there is no warning signal with the driver's door closed, seat belt fastened, and ignition turned on.
